abstract: Stability, rapidity and accuracy are very important performances in Electric Power Steering (EPS). In this paper, it was explained that the contradictions among these performances can't be avoided when using traditional feedback control methods. To resolve this problem, the EPS model and feed-forward control method were studied. And then, a fuzzy PID associate with feed-forward control algorithm was proposed. Through the real vehicle experimental verification, the integrated control algorithm can improve the performance of EPS significantly.

articleTitle: Study on Wavelet Transformation: Used by OFDM in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The electromagnetic environment of the main features in power plants is analyzed, and then the communication system based on OFDM technology was put forward in this paper, the way of selection the wavelet bases function to pass the signal communication system is discussed in the last. The system uses OFDM technology to remove the signal noise in which the cosine carriers of the conventional OFDM system are replaced by the multi-scale orthogonal wavelets transformation, and proposed the use of multi-carrier data transmission strategy, using data classification sub-carrier transmission according to the purpose and nature of the data, the sub-carrier independent of each other. This system exploits the advantage of OFDM, such as strong anti-interference. We compared the typical wavelet basses in practical application, analyzed the effects of the orthogonal bases and its character of orthogonality, compactly supported and vanishing moments in system. The common method for choosing wavelet bases, how to calculate future and direction of development is pointed out.

articleTitle: T-S Model Based Fault Tree Analysis on the Hoisting System of Rubber-Tyred Girder Hoister
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Hoisting system is the key part of the girder hoister, and its reliability determines the stability and security of the girder hoister directly. Hoisting system consists of mechanical, electrical and hydraulic components. Owing to the multiple and complex failure modes and mechanisms of the components, the hoisting system's reliability evaluation is accomplished by Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) based on T-S model. Failure probabilities can be described as fuzzy possibilities and fault degrees are expressed in terms of fuzzy numbers, while events' relationships are described by T-S gates instead of conventional logic gates. A method to acquire knowledge about the premise and consequent events is given, in terms of fuzzy rules of T-S gates made up of fuzzy possibilities and fault degrees of components. Fuzzy possibilities of the intermediate events and the top event are computed by MATLAB, in terms of information about field experiences and expert data. Considering the influence of fault degrees to the system at the same time, it offers reference to find and improve relevant weaknesses of the system, thus the dependability of the whole hoisting system is improved.

articleTitle: Personalized Data Mining Based on Ontology and Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Data mining aims to mine the latent and worthy information from a large amount of data, however customers usually can't express their needs accurately or data resources were not defined specifically, it is often for people to obtain the useful data as well as plentiful of the useless data. Introducing ontology and agent into data mining, Ontology may carry on a more explicit definition in the semantic level, and Agent can help users study, and enable them to define their own demands more precisely, attaining to provide personalized data mining services. Finally, A workflow of personalized data mining based on ontology and agent is Introduced.

articleTitle: Neural Network Applications in Sensor Fusion for a Mobile Robot Motion
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To fully utilize the information from sensors, this paper proposes a technique for autonomous robot safe moving in a partially structured environment. We used fuzzy logic and neural networks to solving the motion planning problem in mobile robot. The method of path construction is based on two neural networks. The first T-S fuzzy neural network is used to fuse the ultrasonic sensor information and to determine the free space. The outputs of the first network and other location information are as inputs of the second multilayer perceptron neural network. The second network is used to finds a safe direction for the next robot section while avoiding the obstacles. The mobile robot could recognize obstacles and environment types online, and decide its action by using the information fusion method put forward. The simulation proved that we realized mobile robot's movement without collision in an obstacles environment. The method above mentioned is also helpful to solve the motion of mobile robot in complex environment comprising mobile obstacles.

articleTitle: FEM Analysis and Design of Sprocket Connecting Shaft on Sintering Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Aimed at structure retrofit of sprocket shaft, combining with the practical working conditions, theoretical calculation, finite element method (FEM) Analysis and model test are applied in research. The results show, numerical value of traditional mechanical algorithm is relative small, FEM can express the influence of actual structure, and results are more reliable. FEM Analysis represents stress distribution of the whole assembly parts and contact pressure, that breaks through the limitation of traditional algorithm, can reflect distribution and magnitude of stress concentration, analysis results have certain reference value to determine the size of appropriate interference fit, optimize part structure, offers theoretical support and numerical reference for engineering application of structure retrofit of sprocket shaft.

articleTitle: Design and Development of SPC90 Slag Pot Carrier of Large Steel Slag Transportation Special Device for Steel Mills
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to ease the contradiction between steel slag transportation and the development of steel mills equipment technology of domestic, the SPC90 slag pot carrier has been designed and developed. The maximum rated load of SPC90 Slag pot Carrier is 90 ton, which can cooperate with many kinds of bridge machine for the railway passenger transport special line to complete the corresponding works, and is the key equipment of steel slag handing production line, which can loading, transport and unloading the steel slag. The operation of drive, steering, braking, and working devices are driven by electro hydraulic proportional control system, which can increase the reliability and interoperability of slag pot carrier, and is easy to realize power matching and energy saving. The hydrodynamic transmission system is adopted for drive, through the combination of the electro-hydraulic power shift control system and three-phase converter, have resolved frequent load changes in driving and the matching of engine. Steering system is electro-hydraulic power steering, which can provide the right road feel to the driver and the solution for the realization of unmanned systems. The wet disc brake system based on electro-hydraulic control system is used, and can increased brake performance and reliability. The close-type load-sensing hydraulic system is used for working device, which improves the composite performance, so that the speed of the luffing and dumping can be controlled in real-time. In this foundation, CAN bus is developed in the electronic control system, and the questions of mechanical drive and control system information integration and disperser control have been solved. At the same time, slag pot carrier also has intellectualized systems as the remote control, anti-collision, fault diagnosis and so on.

articleTitle: A Semi-supervised Text Classification Method Based on Incremental EM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In the standard EM-based semi-supervised text classification, the classification performance is not well when the initial labeled samples are a few. How to improve the performance is an important issue. In view of this, a semi-supervised method based on incremental EM algorithm is proposed. This method makes full use of the useful information of intermediate classifier. On the one hand, this method verifies the feasibility of division existed in unlabeled samples, and uses the division mechanism to enhance the reliability of new incremental samples by dividing the unlabeled samples scientifically; on the other hand, a feedback learning mechanism is proposed, and it is used to decrease the probability of adding misclassified samples. Experimental results show that the classification performance is improved in our method.

articleTitle: An Interior Ballistic Simulation of the Gas-steam Missile Ejection
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: An interior ballistic simulation of the canister launched missiles has been developed with the help of FLUENT. One of the special features of this simulation is the almost uniform acceleration which occurs 0.25s after startup and keeps the missile shockless during ejection. The calculation was done efficiently in FLUENT after setting all the required parameters. Several figures have been given to show the velocity and pressure of the flow field in the reservoir. The variations of the velocity and acceleration with time show that the simulation and the test data of the experiments are in good agreement with each other. This model can be used to analyze the similar launch procedures.

articleTitle: Research on Materials Sequence Supply Model of Mixed-model Production
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Materials are one of the key factors of production. The cost of materials supply takes larger proportion of the total cost of logistics in the manufacturing enterprises. The materials supply system is separated from the production logistics system and establishes an efficient and low-cost materials supply management system which is fit for the characteristics of manufacturing industry, considering the following issues in the mixed-model production, such as high complexity of materials supply management, poor coordination of materials supply systems, high inventory cost and so on. Integrating the basic method of Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and Just In Time (JIT), The model of materials sequence supply is put forward for the mixed-model production and their principles, processes, characteristics and adaptabilities are analyzed, so the entire materials supply system can operate in the formation of cooperation, synchronization, coordination and complementation. The materials supply can cooperate greatly with the real product flows on the mixed-model production lines, eliminate the redundant factors in materials supply systems (including inventory, processes, operations), so logistics can serve production smoothly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Steering System on Vehicle Straight Line
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In Steer Release condition, due to the ability of actual vehicle to resist external small perturbations and self-Adaptive coordination can't be described in the previous vehicle model, the stability of vehicle is described insufficiently. A fine steering system model was established, including Stick-slip friction model and a complete dynamic system consist of wheels, axles, steering tie rod and rack. When encountered with outside interference input, the left and right wheels have the ability to coordinate with each other and ensure the stability of vehicle. The validity of the model is verified through the simulation of typical operating conditions and the fidelity of vehicle model is improved.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Flow Field in Recoil Mechanism Based on Elastic Colloid
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Elastic colloid is a kind of fluid which compression ratio is large under high pressure. It can reduce complexity and volume to apply the elastic in recoil mechanism. The article designed the physical model of recoil mechanism based on elastic gel, made finite element mesh for the model, and build the mathematical model for calculating the fluid movement, conducted a numerical simulation for the flow field inside the recoil mechanism with Fluent software. Simulation reproduced the dynamic process of change of pressure and velocity flow field inside the mechanism, but also provided a reliable basis for design of the recoil mechanism based on elastic colloid.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Scientific and Technical Resources Database System Based on Service Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: During the construction of scientific and technical resources database system two problems are urgent to be solved. The first is how to fully protect existing investment, realize the resource integration, and reduce the construction cost. The second is how to respond to the change of the business needs rapidly, constantly meet applications. It is difficult to solve these two problems with existing mature technology. Service oriented architecture (SOA) offers a solution to the software reuse in distributed environment, and expands and improves the efficiency of software development. By using the SOA principle, the paper realizes the modeling and development of scientific and technical resources database system. The practice has proved that the system has better flexibility and maintainability.

articleTitle: The Research of Automatic Mold Manipulator Control System on PLC
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Automatic mold manipulator control system uses Mitsubishi FX2N series PLC as the control core, KINCO servo system as the main control object, and MCGS touch screen as the terminals. By the use of the external sensors to detect the trigger signal and drive the actuator, and then the manipulator can auto-complete the four process flow operation: feeding - Drawing - Anti-pulling - Punching in each position, which is capable to avoid the risk of manual operation and the shortcomings of low productivity, achieve automation and intelligent of the production, and improve the product quality.

articleTitle: Control Technology of Maximal Wind Energy Capture of VSCF Wind Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the mechanism of VSCF wind turbine in capturing the largest wind, the capturing methods for the largest wind energy are summarized such as the control of the tip speed ratio,, mountaineering search method and three points comparative method. The advantages and disadvantages of the study of those are pointed out. At last the developments of VSCF wind turbine With ADRC in capturing the largest wind are reviewed and prospected in the article.

articleTitle: A New Synchronization Method for MIMO-OFDM Systems with CAZAC Sequence
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A new synchronization method for MIMO-OFDM systems with CAZAC sequence is presented in this paper. Frame timing objective functions is sharpen by using CAZAC Sequence, and its accuracy is also improved. Combing frame and symbol synchronization, only one step is needed for timing algorithm. Reducing the computation load and defining the first channel path accurately. Integral frequency offset correction is achieved in time domain with a lower complexity. The proposed scheme can not only improve the precision of synchronization, but also reduced the complexity greatly. Simulation result shows a better performance than traditional method especially in multi-path channel.

articleTitle: A New Method Based on Local Integral Bispectra and SVM for Radio Transmitter Individual Identification
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To resolve the difficult problem of identifying radio transmitters with the same model, a new method using support vector machine with mixtures of kernels is present for classification of individual transmitters. In this method, the selected local integral bispectra and parameters significant for classification of the received signal form the new identification feature vector. To optimize the classifier, different parameters of kernel function are discussed. The performance of classifier which based on mixtures of kernels is compared with which based on conventional kernel functions. The result of experiments on FM individual transmitters shows that this method is able to achieve better classification rate than conventional kernels even in low SNR.

articleTitle: Research on the Transmission and Execution of the Train Control System Temporary Speed Restriction Command
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses methods of the transmission and execution of the temporary speed restriction in CTCS-0/1, CTCS-2, CTCS-3, compares with their characteristics, points out the security risks exist in CTCS-0/1's method, and proposes a new system based on data radio transceiver wireless data transmission which is suitable for CTCS-0/1. The system realizes closed-loop confirmation between the onboard and ground system of the transmission of temporary speed restriction, equipment automatic execution and supervision of CTC, improves the reliability of the temporary speed restriction information transmission and execution. Furthermore, this paper discusses the composition, working principle and key technologies of the system, and analyses its reliability and security.

articleTitle: A New Network Acceleration Technology Based on Network Server
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: It researches and presents a technology to accelerate data transferring based on high bind-width servers in this paper. The data from users is transmitted by servers that located on the backbone network rented from the network operators, it realizes the acceleration of data transmitting by modifying the routing of the data packet. It introduces the whole progress of data transfer acceleration that the data packet transferred at the client, how to construct the shortest path between servers, then how to transfer the data packet and the experiment to inspect and verify the correctness of this theory. The results of the experiment verify that the theory presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Composite Antibacterial Agent by Chemical Method
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The composite antibacterial agents were prepared with nano-hydroxyapatite containing polyvinyl alcohol, copper ions and zinc ions via the parcels and ion exchange respectively. The as-prepared antibacterial agents were characterized by X-ray diffraction, infrared spectrogram and scanning electron microscopy. The results show that PVA has been wrapped in the surface of hydroxyapatite, and copper and zinc ions had entered the structure of hydroxyapatite. The diameters of the antibacterial ring of Escherichia coli, Candida albicans, Bacillus subtilis and Staphylococcus aureus could be up to 18.32 mm, 14.09 mm, 16.17 mm and 21.05 mm respectively, which reveal that the composites possess excellent and a broad-spectrum antibacterial property.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Study of Students Automatic Learning Under Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: It is a technical difficulty that evaluation of student automatic learning under network environment. In this article, an on-line evaluation system and index system are set up base on fuzzy theory and level analysis method, furthermore, the system be testified working well through questionnaires of teachers, experts and students and practice in the process of network class.

articleTitle: A Structure Evolution Model for Enterprise Group's Value Network
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The enterprise group's value network will evolve along with the change of value units'numbers and their linked ways. According to the analysis of the hierarchy of enterprise group's value network, this paper constructs a structure evolution model for enterprise group's value network based on embeddedness of network. Searches for the evolution rule of enterprise group's value network from an example. The results show that the model is effective and suitable for study on enterprise group's value network's structure evolution.

articleTitle: The Impact of Urban Layout on Traffic Flow Prediction of Intersection
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Urban planning and design is based on traffic flow prediction of intersection to some extent in city, so the rationality of urban planning is influenced by accuracy of intersection prediction. This paper based on traditional Four Phases, considering road improvement near the intersection, predicted the impaction of transfer traffic volume on every run-in of intersection; according to the change of land nature, the paper discussed the impaction of transfer traffic volume of intersection. To sum up, accurate traffic flow of intersection could be obtained in plan year. At the end of the paper we applied this model to the Taizhou five-leg roundabout based on statistical yearbook data, to make sure this method does work.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Urban Commercial Banks Online Median Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The application of information technology and electronic revolution made a lot of new requirements on the reality of the development of traditional industries. In the professional background of endless variety advanced equipment, technology and the universal modular, cross-industry applications, financial institutions, as the first wave of industry acceptance of such radiation, important increasingly for the difference of the site selection and dynamics of institutions set up for continuing source of profit. Urban commercial banks more dependent on this confined to their own conditions. This paper analysis competitive ratio of commercial banks online median problem, from the second-tier layout of the provincial capital city, extends the lower bound of competitive ratio of such field and proved that there is no constant competitive algorithm of the class problem in general, and put forward views on improving the network location selection procession.

articleTitle: Research on IETM Publishing System Based on MVC Pattern
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to better solve the problem that publish IETM (Interactive Electronic Technical Manual) with multiple styles (HTML, PDF, etc), the Struts framework that applies in Web to achieve the traditional MVC pattern was researched in this paper. Based on the traditional Struts framework, this paper proposed a method that replaces the JSP technology with the XSL technology in the view layer. And this method makes the view even more flexible and scalable. Finally, applies the improved MVC pattern to the construct of IETM publishing system to realize the main function of IETM publishing system, which achieves publication of IETM with a variety of styles.

articleTitle: A Novel Numerical Arithmetic of Calculating Bandwidth for a Giant T-Type VLF Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A novel numerical arithmetic of calculating the bandwidth for a high Q and very low frequency (VLF) antenna array was developed. Analyzed the electric current amplitude-frequency characteristic of a VLF T-type antenna array based on the input impedance calculated by Method of Moments (MOM) and interpolated method of Lagrange polynomial. Compared the 3dB bandwidth calculated in numerical arithmetic and classical method with the metrical value of a T-type antenna array. The exactness of the numerical method to calculate the bandwidth was verified. The affection of parameter variation of down lead wires and antenna height on the bandwidth of a T-type antenna was analyzed. Conclusions which can be used for engineering design are obtained.

articleTitle: Optimization of RealVideo Decoder on Godson Microprocessor
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: RealVideo is one of the most popular digital video files on Internet. In this paper, the algorithm complexity and data parallelism of decoding process are analyzed and the RealVideo decoder is optimized with the Godson-2's SIMD multimedia expanded instructions and its architecture features. The results show that these optimizations have improved the performance and efficiency of RealVideo decoding on Godson-2 platform, which have a good guide for other digital video formats on MIPS-like platform.

articleTitle: A System of Multiparameter Data Acquisition about Wattmeter Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A control system of multiparameter data acquisition is introduced. It explains software program direction and realization method about control of wattmeter, process, display and store of the collecting data. The practical application has shown that this system has a good effect. It takes HIOKI3334 on the inspection of energy efficiency for example to introduce the practical application.

articleTitle: Takagi-Sugeno Fuzzy System Based Hierarchical Hybrid Fuzzy-Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy system was merged into Hierarchical Hybrid Fuzzy-Neural Networks (HHFNN) and homogeneous linear function of input variables was employed in the THEN part of fuzzy rules of T-S fuzzy systems. A new training algorithm for this model was also proposed. The parameters consist of the coefficients of homogeneous linear functions and the weights and bias terms of upper neural network. This proposed model has fewer parameters than standard BP network under the same conditions, and outperforms Mamdani fuzzy system based HHFNN and standard BP network in accuracy and error-descent speed according to two simulation examples.

articleTitle: Research and Prospect on Electronic Key Control Technology of Diesel Engine for Heavy Transport Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The electronic control system of heavy-duty, high-power diesel engine used in heavy transport vehicle is studied, and domestic and foreign current development status of the diesel is summarized, and the key technologies as electronic speed control system, high pressure common rail system, exhaust gas recirculation system, electronic throttle control system, power matching of cooling system and etc, the developing trends of diesel engine used in heavy transport vehicle are summarized as well. It is expected the article will be useful to the study of China independent intellectual property of diesel engine used in heavy transport vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on the Precision Grinding Process of Sapphire Lens
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Sapphire crystal material has a good transmittance and its infrared transmittance hardly changes with temperature. Therefore it is widely used in lasers, infrared technology, semiconductors, measuring instruments, defense and aerospace and many other areas. But there still have the problems of low productivity, easy scratching the surface and the surface quality of instability and others on the grinding process of sapphire lens. In order to solve these problems, its precision grinding process has been studied. Through using different performance and specifications of grinding tools, the experimental research was carried out in phases on the grinding process. Then the laser imaging device was used to detect surface quality, and data was theoretically analyzed and calculated and compared with experiment, last the grinding process parameters was optimized. At the end, the process methods and parameters which have important guiding significance for the production of the sapphire lens are summarized.

articleTitle: Using of Cascaded Inverter in Photovoltaic System Controlled by Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Using cascaded inverter in photovoltaic system, when number of cascaded unit increases, unbalance usage becomes a problem. Put forward the balance control method of chaos mapping and the method of photovoltaic power inspecting. It can be concluded from the distribute procedure based on random function that the active probability of each photovoltaic power and switching devices is same. The method of Logistic chaos mapping and tent mapping applied to cascaded inverter are proposed. Also propose the idea of inspect photovoltaic power’s stability by chaos theory.

articleTitle: Research of Search Engine Based on B/S
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: With the development of the plurality of information, offering all the users the same access uniformly cannot meet the further query needs of particular users. This research designs a Chinese Search Engine System based on B/S, which is subject-oriented, supports class classification search, and adopts the technique of database and ASP.NET.

articleTitle: Research of the Drum Rapid Design System Based on Solid Edge Variational Design
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The structures and dimensions of model which has been established in advance have to be modified to suit the different environments in real application. These would cause the numerous and repeated amending design. We studied product design process and variational design technique, then proposed three kinds of methods to actualize variational design, which achieved variational design in 3D parts, model assembly and 2D engineering drawings. At last, a rapid design platform for mechanical product which integrated design knowledge of drum was established. It's testified that the system can rebuild product models more quickly, and promote the design efficiency and quality remarkably.

articleTitle: QSAR Model of Hydroxy- or Methoxy-substituted Benzaldoximes and Benzaldehyde-o-alkyloximes as Tyrosinase Inhibitors
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) study on the tyrosinase inhibition activities of hydroxy- or methoxy-substituted benzaldoximes and benzaldehyde-O-alkyloximes was performed using support vector machines (SVM) method. The predictive power of the models was verified with the leave one out cross validation test and independent test methods. The cross validation squared correlation coefficient value for optimal SVM model was 0.6880. Compared with stepwise multiple linear regression and back propagation artificial neural network models, the SVM model was the most powerful with a square of predictive correlation coefficient of 0.6117 for the test set.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Expert System of the Electrical Traction Shearer Type 3LS
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the C language-based expert system development platform-CLIPS, discusses the CLIPS expert system as a platform shearer 3LS fault diagnosis tool necessity and its concrete realization, and discusses fault diagnosis expert system of the system structure, tectonic theory, the difficulties and at the same time give the implementation program of system based on fault tree.

articleTitle: Study on New Neck Forming Process for Spherical Plain Bearing and Optimum of the Necking Force
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To improve the quality of the self-lubricating spherical plain bearing, a new technology of Two-way neck forming process for the manufacture of the self-lubricating spherical plain bearing was brought out. The shape of the bearing out ring blank was optimized by the parametric finite element method to minimize the necking force in the bearing neck forming process. The two-way necking die was designed and the necking experiment was carried out. The result shows that two-way neck forming process can produce the spherical plain bearing successfully and avoid the defects caused by One-way neck forming process in finished bearing. The shape optimization method for the bearing can decrease the necking force during the neck forming process dramatically.

articleTitle: Communication Design for Vehicle Dynamic Data Exchange
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: With the increasing vehicle use on the road, the collection, processing and transmission of data flow within and outside these vehicles are increasingly complex. These data is often important and sometime critical for drivers and passengers, particularly for remote monitoring and control applications. There are various forms of vehicle data and hence various types of networking used in different vehicle applications. Based on vehicle information flow analysis, a networking system for vehicle remote monitoring and management is designed and their implementations are discussed. A simple communication model is designed and use of 2D barcode block as a basic data unit is suggested.

articleTitle: A Study on the Aluminium Future Market Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the efficiency of aluminum future market by Zipf-typed Analysis model, which was used to natural language field. We transformed the return of aluminum future to a time series only contained the characters of -1, 0, 1 by certain thresholds. We inspected the values of absolute frequencies and relative frequencies of the time series and observed a weak phase transitions phenomena in aluminum future market. It means that noise traders and fundamentalists basically kept their trading behaviors at all time scales. We found every phase is affected by the heterogeneous agents, no-certain agent can control any phase which gave an illustration of aluminum future market efficiency.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Supply Chain Overall-risk Based on Metagraph
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A metagraph is a graphical construction that has been shown to be very useful to graphical visualization and quantitative analysis. In this paper, a Metagraph-based supply chain modeling method for discrete manufacturing industry was proposed. Then a set of metrics of the supply chain overall risk was given, and the algorithms for calculating the risk based on Metagraph model was proposed. Finally, a case study was given to validate our method. The calculating results show that it is a very effective quantitative appraisal method before the supply chain has actually been constructed.

articleTitle: Preliminary Analysis on the 3G-interview
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper defines the concept of E-interview, analyze the advantage of E-interview and elaborate the reason of the application scope of the E-interview in the current personnel selection. This paper not only points out the important position and the applicable scope of the E-interview in the current personnel select, but also does the basic estimate to the application foreground of the E-interview. For making good use of E-interview in the business and government, it also gives some suggestions about the preparation of the hardware and applicants.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Performance Parameter of Metal Rubber
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Metal Rubber is special materials and used in aerospace, especially under extreme conditions. It has characteristics of strong adaptability, corrosion resistance, radiation resistance and designability. In this paper, we have manufactured Metal Rubber components, and done some research on the influence of previous deformation to Metal Rubber material's structure and performance, its characteristic parameters such as Poisson's ratio, Elastic modulus were studied. Research results are basic but essential for finite element analysis of Metal Rubber materials; these results also play an important role of engineering application.

articleTitle: Study on the Choices of Park and Ride Based on Discrete Choice Models
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Bicycling is one of the most important modes of urban transportation in China. The objective of this study is to develop a procedure to identify the factors affecting travelers' choice of the park-and-ride trip mode. Two trip alternatives were considered, including the bicycling and the park-and-ride trip mode. In this study, a multinomial logit model structure was proposed and the use of the model was explained using a case study. The factors considered in the model include the travel time, travel cost, walking distance, the need for second transfer, and the health condition of travelers. Even though the data used for model specification was not real survey data, the modeling procedure proposed by this study can be followed by transportation planners to develop discrete choice models to help make various design decisions regarding the application of the park-and-ride mode.

articleTitle: A New Method of Multiple Factors Analysis of Cell Coverage Based on the Real Measured Data
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In mobile network, a deviation of cell coverage area will influence many performance indexes, cell coverage analysis is vital to network optimization. The traditional check method is road testing by manpower which costs much time and resource. This paper presents a new method to analyze the cell coverage area based on phone measured data collected in OMC system. The cell coverage analysis algorithm considers multiple factors such as signal level distribution, sampling point's distribution and category of interferences to analyze the cell coverage deviations. The calculation and analysis results are presented in map based on GIS platform. Contract with the traditional way, this method is more economic, support real-time and the way showing results is more intuitive.

articleTitle: Design of Small 180-degree Electronic Stripping Tester
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces a small type of 180° Electronic Stripping Tester, taking single-chip microcomputer as a control core. Combined with mechanical design, the machine extends the control unit of the signal detection, LED display and motor control. It can test the quality of non-metallic products, such as the viscosity of adhesive tapes and the strength of woven belts. It can also test real-time value, average, maximum.

articleTitle: Design of Test System on Nighttime Driving Behavior and ECG Characteristics of Long-distance Bus Drivers (II) - Experimental Result Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the night long-distance bus drivers were the study object, an integrated test system with long time real-time continuous acquisition of ECG characteristics of drivers, traffic parameters of vehicles and road environment image acquisition were designed.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Electrode of Flue Gas Desulphurization by Discharge Corona Plasma
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: It is one of the focuses which are paid wide attention in the environmental protection field that the advanced and feasible desulphurization technologies are studied. Desulphurization technology by corona discharge is a novel and promising dry process for flue gas treatment. In flue gas desulphurization by corona discharge, the discharge characteristic of four electrode in direct current power and pulsed power were studied on the basis of desulphurization tests. It is resulted that under the same condition, desulphurization efficiency of pulsed power exceeds that of direct current power. By contrast ranking discharge characteristic of four electrodes, desulphurization efficiency of nozzle electrode is the first, sawtooth electrode is the second, spinous electrode is the third, the star electrode is the fourth. The reason is that discharge characteristic of electrodes lies on curvature radius. It is showed that desulphurization efficiency of ammonia coming in reactor from nozzle electrode is higher than that from pipe of fuel entrance.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Carbide Tool Wear on Milling Ti6Al4V with Water Vapor Cooling and Lubricating
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The machinability of Titanium Alloy Ti6Al4V is poor, the traditional methods to machining is application of cutting fluids with the active additives which cause environmental pollution and health problems. In this paper, the water vapor was applied on milling instead of cutting fluid for the aim of green milling Ti6Al4V. The effects of water vapor, oil emulsion and dry cutting on tool wear have been examined in milling of titanium alloy Ti6Al4V with carbide tools YG6, the wear morphology of rake and flank tool face was studied. The results of experiments indicated that application of water vapor reduced the tool wear and increased the tool life.

articleTitle: On Numerical Methods for Second Order PDE
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper is composed of two sections. The job of the people such as Z. Cai. and R. Lazarov was introduced in the first section, their idea is to use first order system least squares for solving second order partial differential equations. The simplest case of first order elliptic system is Cauchy-Riemann equation, so the difference schemes of Cauchy-Riemann equation was studied in the second section.

articleTitle: A Bi-directional Resource Reservation Proposal for Hard Congestion
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: For real-time multimedia communication has strict QoS (Quality of Service) requirements for network, especially it is very sensitive to packet loss rate and delay jitter. When the communication network becomes seriously congested, a Bi-directional Resource Reservation model solution is proposed. This scheme supports the QoS priority and Bi-directional Reservation. The results show that the internal node maintenance in the scheme of Bi-directional Resource Reservation model is based on distinguishing the reserve service level, which has good expansibility and flexibility.

articleTitle: An Advanced Instantaneous Detection Method for Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Active power filter is an effective device to clear harmonics. Accurate detection of compensated components decides its compensation effect directly. This paper proposes an advanced instantaneous detection method for distorted three-phase system voltage by detecting fundamental positive sequence voltage and current respectively using d-q transformation. Thus fundamental positive-sequence active current and the compensated current components can be obtained exactly by phasor projection. The detection of voltage and current are simultaneous. Simulation results illustrate efficiency and accuracy of the improved method.

articleTitle: Study of Rate Assignment on the Downlink of WCDMA
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In WCDMA system, rate assignment algorithm on the downlink for the data transmission is proposed. The optimization goal of the resource allocation strategy is choosing appropriate utility function. The utility function reflects a flexible tradeoff between total system throughput and fairness. The power is distributed through the control module and the scheduling module. The simulations show the performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Research on New Electrohydraulic Rectifying Control System of Hydraulic Formation Machines
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The Rectifying Control System is a important system for the Hydraulic Formation Machines, and directly effects the accuracy of the construction. It will demonstrate the excellent performance of Rectifying accuracy of the system in this paper, by the development of New electro-hydraulic Rectifying Control System and the large work of experimental test. That was a new attempt for some structures and the electro-hydraulic system, which achieved better effect and gave a good reference.

articleTitle: Study on Compressor Health Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper applies prognostics and health management technologies to compressor system for the first time. Firstly, the meaning of compressor health management system is elaborated. Secondly, the study contents and hierarchical structure of compressor system are expounded. Finally, this paper proposes the concept of compressor integrated health index and give the major steps of calculating compressor integrated health index based on TOPSIS method.

articleTitle: A Modified Speech Blind Separation Method Based on Information Maximum
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A new algorithm based on information maximization is proposed, against the shortcomings of traditional Speech Blind separation of low convergence rate and high crosstalk error. It uses the new sign function to make mutual information of input and output to maximize by analyzing a variety of non-linear function of the separation performance. Experiments show that the new algorithm has advantages, such as fast convergence, small crosstalk error and good separation efficiency which compared with traditional methods of Be11's and Sejnowskl's.

articleTitle: Ambient Illumination Consistency Based on Hue Method in a Mixed-scene
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Illumination makes an important role in realistic graphics rendering, especially in the mixed-scene rendering based on the geometric models and images. Adjusting illumination effect is a key step to achieve realistic scene when the images are inconsistent with the virtual environment. Therefore, complicated processing is required to generate the image with desired illumination condition. Using the technology of model rendering pipeline based on GPU, this paper presents a hue method to generate consistent ambient illumination between image and geometric models in a mixed-scene without specular and shadow. With this method, we can render the novel image under different ambient lights, and need not a lot of image data.

articleTitle: Multi-functional Power Parameter Harmonic Detection System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To meet the urgent demand of electric power industry for harmonic energy measurement, energy meter low stability and precision, a three phase multi-functional and high-precision power parameter harmonic detection system has been developed. Electric instrumentation using of DSP on the three-phase voltage, three-phase current synchronize the entire cycle of uniform sampling and anti-aliasing tracking filter. And use of graphic LCD technology, high-speed computing, processing and data analysis is to achieve energy meter data management, automatic control, fault protection. Harmonic energy measurement algorithm based on hanning window double-spectrum-line interpolation FFT for improving spectral leakage and fence effect of FFT was discussed. The correction method of ratio error and phase error of harmonic energy measurement was also discussed. The running results show that multi-functional harmonic detection system voltage and current errors are less than 0.5, active power and reactive power errors are less than 0.3%, voltage and current harmonic distortion is less than 0.5%, and harmonic phase measurement error is less than 3°. System is accurate, reliable data transmission, easy to operate and function.

articleTitle: CAD Simulation Study on the Principle of Tapping with Modified-tooth Tap
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Based on mathematical modeling of the principle of tapping with modified-tooth tap, the results of 2D simulation have been obtained, establishing 3D solid structure model of modified-tooth tap, simulating the actual manufacturing conditions in software of Solidworks, thus proving the possibility of tapping the thread of standard tooth profile angle with the modified-tooth tap of which the thread tooth profile angle is less than that of standard tap.

articleTitle: The Adaptability of Urban Traffic Infrastructural Investment and Traffic Demand
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Urban traffic supply capacity and feature is much related with traffic infrastructure investment structure which can affect the traffic jam. The paper discussed the relation of traffic investment with traffic demand. And sum up the feature of traffic investment, the coordination models of investment. At last, based on Beijing traffic development program2012, we designed the forecasting plan of public traffic infrastructural investment by using multi-objective optimize approach and computing with Matlab software, and traffic infrastructural investment field, its structure and police suggestion.

articleTitle: Decomposition of Health Cost and Modeling of Asset Allocation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: People spend a lot of money to keep healthy. So health problem has affected investors' earnings and their decision of asset allocation. By means of thinking about the relative effect of health problem this paper proposed an optimization model and solved it in single period. Meanwhile an empirical demonstration about the relationship between life expectancy and social cost was adopted. After discussion we believe that health factors may increase the volatility of wage income, thereby reduce investors' allocation ratio on risk asset; but when wage income risk is independent on investment return, investors will increase investment ratio. The main innovation of this paper is that decomposing the cost of health, building a model of asset allocation by the way of health factors and solving it in single period.

articleTitle: The Joint Distribution Effect on the Deformation Size Effect of Rock Mass
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Using the similar material and simulating test block joint by prepared vitriol paper, the scale effect on deformation of five kinds of fractal distribution joint rock mass is studied, in which the deformation of rock simulate block is obtained form the test on the same scale. On the base of analyzing the deformation change with the scale or the joint distribution dimension, the planar empirical equation is put forward. It is concluded that the rock ductility law increasing with the number argument of rock masses joint is deduced, however, the damage process and way are controlled by the joint distribution.

articleTitle: Research of Embedded Reliable Transmission Protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at embedded system's requirement of the wireless network application, this paper proposes a simple, reliable and practical transmission protocol. The protocol reserves all functions and high-efficiency character of UDP and realizes real-time and reliable transmission with reliable process flow, batch retransmit mechanism. Experiments showed that the proposed protocol could achieve high reliable transmission ability, keep nicer bandwidth utilization, and afford efficiency and reliable service for upper layer.

articleTitle: Material and Structural Optimization for Engine Hood Inner Panel of Car Body Aimed to Lightweight
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A method of lightweight design based on material selection and structural optimization is developed for engine hood inner panel. Introduced the decision-making mechanism of multi-objective satisfaction degree to lightweight material selection, built the model of finite element analysis and computer experiment analysis of the strength, stiffness and modal properties respectively to the different lightweight material for selected, Programmed with MatLAB and realized the lightweight material optimal selection. Then performed topology structural optimization to the inner panel with the selected lightweight material properties, which realized the integrated performance improved to different level and the weight of the inner panel reduced by 30.4%. The case study of lightweight design based on lightweight material selection and structural optimization shows the feasibility and potential of the method, and it provide an reference for the lightweight design of car body.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis and Numerical Simulation of Dynamic Characteristics of Hydrostatic Guides for Heavy NC Machine Tool
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Based on analysis of hydrostatic bearing with circular pocket, equations of static pressure, volvme pressure and squeezing pressure which influence dynamic characteristics of hydrostatic guides with rectangle pocket have been deduced. The function and their influencing factors of the three kinds pressure mentioned above are clarified. The amplitude-phase-frequency characteristics of the hydrostatic guides system have been analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively, it is indicated that the sensitive oil volume has greater effect on the stability of the guide, the volume should be reduced as small as possible while the hydrostatic guides meet the needs of the field working situation. To increasing the oil visosity properly is also helpful to improve the dynamic performance of hydrostatic guides.

articleTitle: Broadband Beam Forming for Circular Sensor Array via Modal Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A new method of broadband constant beamwidth beam-forming for circular arrays is proposed in this paper. The design requirements of this method were specified by the weights which formed the low-side-lobe beams of each sub-band over the broad frequency band. The low-side-lobe beams of each sub-band which expands the expected beam using orthogonal series, obtains the orthogonal series coefficients by optimization method, gets array element weights according to the physical mechanism, and then composes its direction. The beam forming on the circular sensor array is optimized on the computer. The side-lobe is lowed with the appropriate main lobe using the proposed method. The method can be used in multifold application occasions on the beam forming design and optimization effectively.

articleTitle: The L_2-L_{\infinity} Control for Leader-following Coordination with Switching Topology
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> leader-following coordination problems with undirected switching topologies and external disturbance. The agent dynamics is expressed in the form of a second-order model and the control laws are neighbor-based feedback laws. We first establish a LMI sufficient condition to guarantee that all following agents can track the leader agent and the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> disturbance attenuation of the system is not greater than a given constant. Furthermore, we get a explicit estimation expression of L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> disturbance attenuation by constructing a parameter-dependent common Lyapunov function. Finally, a numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination of the Multi-grade Surge Protective for Secondary System in Substation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: If lightning damage occurs in substations, huge block would be caused out in a large area, and lots of trouble would be brought to social production and daily life. So it requires that lightning protection should be reliable. Presently, the lightning protection measures of high voltage system are perfect, while the secondary system mainly consists of plenty of electronic, micro-electronic, etc LV devices, which make the withstanding voltage standard fairly low. With the smart grid presentation, there will be more new information technology and more LV devices will be used in substations, so higher demand on reliability of lightning protection is put forward. This paper put forward a multi-grade surge protective for secondary system in substation using surge protective devices in order to achieve superior overall performance and using electromagnetic transient program (EMTP) analysis of the performance of their protection and parameter coordination.

articleTitle: Mining Frequent Correlated-Quasi-Cliques from PPI Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Many of the previous studies show convincing arguments that mining frequent subgraphs is especially useful. Many hidden frequent patterns which are very interesting can not be found by mining single graph. Previous studies as Quasi-Clique have little success with the hub problem. In this paper, we introduce a new conception Correlated-Quasi-Clique and develop a novel algorithm, CoClique, to address the hub problem and improve the efficiency of frequent correlated-Quasi-Cliques mining. Meanwhile, we exploit several effective techniques to prune the search space. An extensive experimental evaluation on real databases demonstrates that our algorithm outperforms previous methods.

articleTitle: The Inference Strategy of Concrete Crack In Expert System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Harmful cracks in construction is quite complex, and it is hard to judge the real reasons and propose the remedial treatment. The expert system of concrete quality diagnosis can help the technician to make the decision fastly like the perienced expert. This paper described the expression of crack in knowledge base and the inference engine. It exampled the hamful crack occuring in the ChongYang reservoir bridge to explain the entire inference prosess. The prosess mainly used uncertainty reasoning method (reliability method) and the forward inference reasonning. The result from expert system and the analysis from experts is similar, so the model and inference strategy is valid.

articleTitle: Collinear Competition between Rail Transit and Bus Transit Based on Population Competition Model
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The paper discusses the collinear competition problem between urban rail transit and conventional bus transit. It compares ecological population competition with collinear transit competition, and utilizes ecological theories and means to solve the collinear competition problem between transit modes. A collinear competition model between rail transit and bus transit based on Lotka-Volterra population competition model is set up to analyze the competition mechanism quantitatively and search for the equilibrium. The real data are applied for demonstration and some reliable conclusions are obtained.

articleTitle: Service Planning and Strategy for the Official Statistics of Fixed Asset Investment in China Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The fixed asset investment plays the important role in industrial economy increase and structure adjustment, and statistics of fixed asset investment is the basic tool to reflect the relationship and rule of this kind of economy phenomenon. In China, the Ministry of Transportation takes in charge of the statistics of fixed asset investment in highway and waterway transportation. By summarizing the statistics form system, data collection channel, informationization level, and analyzing the suitability of statistics information resources, some suggestion on the service planning and strategy of official statistics of fixed asset investment in transportation are put forward which are about statistics system construction, data quality evaluation and data mining.

articleTitle: Device Producing Fluctuant Load of ABS in Automobile
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A set of device producing fluctuant load of Antilock Braking System (ABS) was developed by means of system integration in order to analyze the characteristics of pipe line pressure transmitting, optimize system structure and improve con-trolling quality. Experiments were carried out with and without ABS respectively. The experiment data provided references for the option and verification of pump. A driving motor was chosen according to the maximum working pressure and the largest flow, and the driving circuit was also designed. The device can provide assistance to parameter identification for pipeline and system analysis.

articleTitle: The Test of Inner-flue Tube Wall Temperature of Superheater Based on the Power Plant SIS
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Superheater and reheater tube failures were mostly due to excessive temperature, the inner-flue tube wall temperature of superheater make certain of tube thermal stress, material creep status and residual lifespan of tubes. So investigation of superheater safety began with experimentation of inner-flue tube wall temperature of superheater. In order to precisely learn inner-flue tube wall temperature of superheater of 600MW supercritical boiler, new measuring points are set on the superheater tube wall inner the flue. Since the working condition of 600MW supercritical boiler is quite severe, the temperature measuring points can only be used for short-term test. The data acquisition can be carried out automatically and a data storage system is required. The testing method in this paper transmit the measuring signal to the database of the thermal power control system through the redundant channel of the system. This method only requires new measuring points (thermocouple). The test data can be loaded directly from the SIS database, which saves not only money but also the work.

articleTitle: 600 MW Supercritical Boiler's Main Steam Temperature Control Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Main Steam Temperature is an important parameter for boiler's safety and economically operating that must be controlled at design point strictly by using control system. The characteristics and methods of Control system on 600 MW Supercritical Boiler's Main Steam temperature were described in this paper. Operation information is given and shown that the main steam temperature overheating appears commonly in actual operation process. In order to precisely learn the working condition of 600MW supercritical boiler, new temperature measuring points are set on the superheater tube wall inner the flue. The experimental results shown that the tube wall temperature changes swiftly with the load variation. There is significant temperature bias between testing cells at same superheater stage.

articleTitle: The Synergistic Effect between Nano-Cu Lubricating Additives and Electroless Deposited Ni-W-P Coating
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The tribological properties of nano-Cu lubricating additives and electroless deposited Ni-W-P coating as well as their synergistic effect are researched using ring-block abrasion testing machine and Energy Dispersive Spectrometer. Research results show that the wear resistance of Ni-W-P alloy coating after heat treatment at 400°C has greatly increased since the Second Phase Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>P particles were educed. In the friction process, nano-Cu in the lubricating additives deposited on the friction surface of Ni-W-P alloy coating so as to form a protective lubricating film, therefore the antiwear and friction reducing effects are achieved by the micro polishing effect, the load effect of micro ball bearing, the filling and repairing effects and formation of the chemical reaction film on the friction surface. Experiment results confirm that Ni-W-P alloy coating and nano-Cu lubricating additive have excellent synergistic effect, and form double protection for the metal substrate, e.g., the wear resistance of Ni-W-P alloy coating (with heat treatment and the oil with nano-Cu additives) has increased hundreds times than 45 steel as the metal substrate with the basic oil, zero wear is achieved, which break through the bottleneck of previous separate research of the above-mentioned the two.

articleTitle: A Call Admission Control Algorithm For Different QoS in Multihop Wireless Lans
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: For MAC (Media Access Control) protocol not providing QoS(Quality of Service) guarantees. With the increase of multimedia sevices in wireless networks(for example:voice, video, etc), when the networks get crowded, real-time applications will decrease its performance. We proposed a wireless network algorithm for 802.11e, witch supports fixed nodes and mobile nodes, and also swiches and new connections. Results imply that it can provide QoS guarantees under the existing vioce and video traffic, at the same time, it maintains a good performance in a most effective channel.

articleTitle: Application of Catastrophe Evaluation Method in Risk Assessment of SMS in Civil Aviation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the problems of needing to determine the weights of index system in most comprehensive evaluation methods of risk assessment in civil aviation, and the calculation was too complicated; catastrophe evaluation method was applied to the risk assessment of SMS in civil aviation. Indicators were analyzed and sorted, and then the standard of the bottom indicators was performed. The ultimate catastrophe evaluation values were obtained by the normalization formulas. The calculation of MatLab eliminated the defect of the much higher catastrophe evaluation values and made the converted values more practical. At last, the example verified the feasibility, validity and practicality.

articleTitle: Energy Analysis of Cofiring Food Waste with Coal for Electricity Generation System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Cofiring food waste with coal for electricity generation has not only reduce fossil fuel costs, but can lower the greenhouse gases (GHGs), NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> emissions. However, there are some pitfalls to impact on its commercialization and sustainable development. The emergy analysis theory provides a new idea quantitatively analyzing the relationship between the natural environment, socio-economic systems and the cofring food waste with coal for electricity generation system. In this paper, as the case of a 140 MW cofiring food waste with coal system in Southern China, the emergy analysis of the cofring food waste with coal for electricity generation system was conducted and its emergy sustainability indices were established. The results showed that the competitiveness of cofiring system was no advantage to the single coal-based power system, but its pressure to the environment is obviously smaller. The cofiring food waste with coal electricity generation system has more sustainable performance than the other fossil power plants.

articleTitle: The Research of Key Stream Produced by New Method and its Attack Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper puts forward a new method that can get encrypt sequence with the new encrypt method. The results show that this method is effective and the new sequence can pass the random test.

articleTitle: Stress Field Analysis around the Residual Oil Film in Formation Micro-pore with Polymer Flooding
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: There is still nearly 40% of the crude oil remaining in the rock strata formed in residual oil after primary and secondary recovery. In order to improve oil recovery, to find the residual oil recovery method, to further improve the theoretical system of polymer flooding. Through the establishment of constitutive equation and flow equation and the boundary conditions suitable for describing the flow of viscoelastic fluid of polymer solution, applying computational fluid dynamics software, stress field around the residual oil film in formation micro-pore was calculated, stress was given around the residual oil film on the lipophilic rock surface with different situations of polymer solution, relationship between the viscoelasticity of polymer solution and the force around the residual oil film was analyzed. The results show that: The viscoelasticity of polymer solution is the main reasons for non-uniform stress distribution around the residual oil film, increasing the viscoelasticity of polymer solution, the stronger of the non-uniformity around the residual oil film, more beneficial to the deformation of residual oil film, further split and to reach the launch conditions of residual oil.

articleTitle: The Polishing Machine Grinding-head's Noise Analysis and Control in the Ceramic Profession
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the reasons of the construction ceramic polishing machine noise generated have been analyzed, a noise reduction program has been put forward in accordance with existing conditions and test equipment, the noise of working polishing machine has been tested to the ordinary circumstances and under water, the test data had indicated that adding water can reduce the noise of the working ceramic polishing machine, so that the program is effective and practical.

articleTitle: The Performance of Decorrelator in Non-Gaussian Noise
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we modify background noise of multi-user detection, by selecting non-Gaussian noise of more harshly conditions such as Laplace noise and Alpha-Stable noise. Under the traditional DEC algorithm, Comparing the BER of the two noises with Gaussian noise, which can get close to real complex environment and be beneficial to further research.

articleTitle: Study on Changes in the Coefficient of Adhesion of Vehicle after the Effects of Deicing Salt
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: It is a brief introduction of the working principle of deicing salt and its applications at present in China. Utilizing an easy method for testing road coefficient of adhesion and taking the braking laws of China GB12676-1999 (Automotive braking system structure, performance and test methods) into account, a test program to test the coefficient of adhesion is developed. The data based on the experiment, changes in the coefficient of adhesion of Vehicle after the Effects of Deicing Salt are discussed.

articleTitle: Eco-toxicity of Three Nitroaromatics Pollutants to Freshwater Fish Exposed to Controlled Conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to obtain some basic data for eco-toxicological tests, acute lethal toxicities of o-nitrochlorobenzene, m-nitrochlorobenzene and 2,4-dinitrotoluene in aquatic environment to Brocarded Carp were investigated. Brocarded Carp was employed and introduced into different test solutions contained three compounds. LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> defined within 96 h was calculated by the mortality of fish using the Karbers method. The pretest showed that the 24 h LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">100</sub> concentrations of 2,4-DNT, M-NCB, O-NCB were 33, 40, 50 mg/L and 96 h LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> concentrations of 2,4-DNT, M-NCB, O-NCB were 6, 20, 25 mg/L, respectively. the most acutely toxic among the tested chemicals was 2,4-DNT, with a LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> of 19.67 mg/L for Brocarded carp, the 96 h LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> value of O-CNB and M-CNB were 36.48 mg/L and 33.5 mg/L, respectively. Based on 96 h LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> values, the rank order of chemicals from most toxic to least toxic was: 2,4-DNT>M-NCB>O-NCB. These results were in consistent with the structure-activity theory. LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> revealed highly significant linear relationships between the short-time biological endpoints and the dosage of three chemicals. The test results indicated that the number of nitro substituent of nitroaromatics compounds were positive correlation with the acute toxicity of nitroaromatics compounds to fish and the toxicity of nitro substituent was greater than that of chlorine substituent. This paper may give some consults for ecological risk assesses of nitroaromatics compounds and their analogues.

articleTitle: The Research and Implementation of a New Computing Model
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The paper presents an original theory of computing infrastructure, which is quasi-holographic-element system theory. Based on this theory, a new type model that is quasi-holographic element mathematical model is formed. It reflects kinds of operation relations of number. The characteristics of the new model check and store going the same way, synchronization of compute and check, integrative store and calculation, exchange, operation and control in its entirety. On the basis of the theory to construct the corresponding physical model, using Quartus II9.0 development platform, the model accomplished EP2S180F1020C3 FPGA. The results showed that the model is able to change the word length of computing device based on operand length, have the equal speed between computing and frequency, and achieve high speed computing at low frequency and so on. It also can be used to constitute a function complementary system of the computers according to the relevant original theory.

articleTitle: The Study on Combustion Kinetics Characteristic of Biology-molding Fuel
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Thermogravimetric (TG-DTG) analysis was used to study the pyrolysis characteristics of biology-molding fuel (corn straw and bean straw) at different heating rates in a stream of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. We determine the kinetic parameters including reaction order, frequency factor and activation energies of straw that guided design for combustion boiler using biology-molding fuel.

articleTitle: Regulatory Module Network of Basic/Helix-loop-helix Transcription Factors During Bovine Preimplantation Development in vivo
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The basic/helix-loop-helix (bHLH) proteins are important components of the transcriptional regulatory network, play pivotal roles in embryonic development. In order to understand the regulatory mechanisms of bHLH Transcription factors (TFs) in developing bovine embryos, we inferred their regulatory network from genome-wide gene expression profiles with the module networks method. A regulatory network comprising 12 important bHLH TFs and 357 target genes was constructed. The network was divided into 25 modules based on expression profiles. In addition, 18 cooperative bHLH TF pairs were also detected in the network. This cooperation suggests possible regulation between TFs. Interestingly, lots of TFs in the network regulate more than one module.
