A novel cross-repression between ID3 and HEYL was identified, which may control various functions in different developing stages. Our network will help in the analysis of mechanisms underlying embryonic losses and for improving in vitro culture systems.

articleTitle: The Design of Tensile Testing Machine Based on MCGS Control System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: MCGS (Monitor and Control Generated System, Universal Monitoring System) is a set of configuration software for rapidly constructing and generating computer monitoring system. It can provide solutions, which solve practical engineering program, and also be run on the Microsoft (all 32-bit Windows platform). The data, which is acquainted on site, can be displayed with a variety of ways, such as animation, alarm processing, process control, real-time curve, the historical curve and the report output. It takes full advantage of the Windows' features, such as graphics, good interface consistency, easy-to-use, so it has a more widespread application in the automation field. The tensile test machine control system was designed on the basis of MCGS software industrial control system.

articleTitle: Spectrum Estimation of Pseudo-random Nonuniformly Sampled Signals in the Fractional Fourier Transform Domain
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The fast Fourier transform (FFT) and the fast fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) are used widely in signal processing for uniformly sampled signals. However, in many applications, nonuniform sampling is required in the frequency domain. And the theories and applications of nonuniformly sampled signals in the time and frequency domain have been studied and have a lot of advantages. In this paper, we intend to extend these theories to the fractional Fourier transform domain. First, introduce the digital spectrum (the discrete Fourier transform) of nonuniformly sampled signals. And then analyze the digital spectrum of nonuniformly sampled signals in the Fractional Fourier transform domain. Finally, present two examples and make simulations. The result shows that these theories are also effective in the fractional Fourier transform domain.

articleTitle: Parallel Computing for Dynamic Asset Allocation Based on the Stochastic Programming
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a multi-stage stochastic programming model is constructed, for the dynamic asset allocation with the transaction cost constraints. In the mean time in order to improve the performance, the Conditional Value-at-Risk as the risk measure, which is a very important concept in the modern risk management field, is also contained. However, with the increase of the number of scenarios, the number of constrains and decisions variable is increasing dramatically. It turns out that the memory management is a major bottleneck when solving planning problems. For this reason, this paper shows that the dedicated model generations, and the specialized solution techniques based on high performance computing, are the essential elements to tackle this large-scale financial planning. The parallel code is programmed by the C language, and the Message Passing Interface (MPI) for communication is utilized. The parallel and financial performance is performed on the DeepComp7000.

articleTitle: A Reversible Data Hiding Algorithm Based on Multiple Extended Codebooks
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new VQ(vector quantization) -based reversible data hiding scheme using multi-extended codebooks. The algorithm has large capacity, high PSNR. It can also extract secret data completely without the participation of original image. Since the new method of codebook classification, the proposed algorithm transmits less information in order to extract the secret data and has simple computational complexity. Additionally, more secret data can be embedded, because that all the codebooks are used to embed information.

articleTitle: Fluid Temperature and Power Estimation of Geothermal Power Plants by a Simplified Numerical Model
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an estimation of power generated in a given geothermal heat pipe system. Such power generation is basically controlled by the ultimate temperature of fluid flowing through the u-shape pipes and could also be affected by power consumption of pumps. The ultimate fluid temperature can be simulated by a simple numerical model for studying thermal behavior of soil-fluid material. Model results illustrated that the critical net power of geothermal power plants is restrained by the flow rate of the fluid which is limited by the current pump behavior. Comparison between geothermal heat pipe systems with different physical properties demonstrated the u-shape pipe with a larger design depth and a higher design velocity could produce larger amount of power.

articleTitle: Research on the Incomplete Constellation GPS Positioning Algorithm by a Combined Altitude and Clock Bias Model
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: GPS positioning is normally required that four GPS satellites are in view at least. However, due to the frequent blockage of GPS signals in worse environmental condition, such as canyons, forests and high buildings and so on, it is difficult to receive the signals of four satellites, that is GPS incomplete constellation. Therefore, the operation of the GPS receiver may be interrupted. Aiming at the poor positioning feature under GPS incomplete constellation environment, the altitude estimating improved algorithm aiding the receiver to positioning is put forward. Moreover, an auxiliary method for GPS receiver positioning using clock bias forecast model is developed. The combined altitude and clock bias model algorithm was introduced into the pseudorange equations, which ensured the service of GPS receiver could be continuous even in incomplete constellation. Even the GPS receiver can only receive the signals of two satellites. The validation and analysis based on the real GPS data show that this proposed method increases the availability of GPS positioning.

articleTitle: Impact of Planting Grass on Loessial Earthen Road with Different Slope Gradients to Avoid Runoff and Erosion
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The transportation and environmental systems are destroyed by runoff and soil losses from unpaved earthen hillside roads on the Loess Plateau in China. We constructed artificial road sections (2.0 m long, 0.55 m wide and 0.35 m deep) with loessial soil packed to give a representative bulk density of 1.5 g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and with different slope gradients (6°, 9°, 12°, 15° and 18°). Ten sections were planted with 50% grass coverage and another ten were bare as control treatments. Simulated rainfall (120 mm/h for 1 hour) was applied to the road sections and the hydraulic characteristics of the overland flow generated, and the amount of runoff and sediment yield produced over time, were examined. For any given slope gradient, grass inhibited overland flow as indicated by lower Froude and Reynolds numbers, higher friction and surface roughness as indicated by Manning and Darcy-Weisbach coefficients, and lower mean flow velocities. Lower impact energies of raindrops intercepted by the grass led to less surface seal formation and detachment of soil particles. This in turn resulted in amounts of runoff and sediment from the grassed roads with different slope gradients, which were 7.7%~13.1% and 47.3%~60.4% smaller than those from the bare roads, respectively. Reductions in sediment yields, which were linearly related to the slope gradient, were also attributable to reduced carrying capacity of the runoff. Therefore, grass growing on loessial earthen roads can mitigate soil losses effectively and, to a lesser degree, runoff amounts.

articleTitle: The Study of VCO Automatic Test System Base on GPIB Bus
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of 3G communications, RF circuits are becoming more widespread, so the electronic components VCO's applications grows ever wider, because it is the core module in the oscillator circuit. A voltage-controlled oscillator automatic test system based on GPIB bus is introduced. This system and computer combination has changed the traditional manual operation, VCO production efficiency has been greatly improved; many parameters can be measured easily, the testing accuracy and reliability are all high, the investment is lower and intelligent function is stronger.

articleTitle: Recycling Investigation on Household Electrical Appliances in China
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The production of electric and electronic equipment is one of the fastest growing areas. This development has resulted in an increase of waste household electrical appliances (WHEA). In view of the environmental problems involved in the management of WHEA, many counties and organizations have drafted national legislation to improve the reuse, recycling and other forms of recovery of such wastes so as to reduce disposal. The existing recycling system (direct way to material recycling) is one solution for both saving materials and reducing environmental impact. But the recycled value is very limited [1] [2] and loosing values of used HEA. The purpose of this paper is intended to have clear picture on the demand of second hand market of used HEA to propose optimal recycling system in China. In this paper, market research on used HEA in eastern part of China is presented. The market research was held in Liaoning province, Jilin province, Helongjiang province, Hebei province and Beijing city in 2008. The used HEA related to the research covers with computers, TVs, refrigerators, washing machines, air-conditioners, video recorders, radios and mobile phones, etc. From the market research data and based on Chinese economic disparity condition, a new scheme (HEA⇒Used HEA⇒Second-hand HEA⇒ Refurbished HEA⇒Used HEA⇒Wasted HEA) is proposed for Chinese Used HEA, be differential from developed countries for example as Japan or European Unions.

articleTitle: A Fast Generation Method of Bent Sequences and Its Application in ADS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Sequence design is an important role in spread spectrum systems, where the issue of Bent sequence has received wide attentions. Thus this paper investigates the Bent sequence generation by using m-sequence and its shift versions, which can generate a family of Bent sequence quickly. As an aplication, ADS (Advanced Design System) 2005A software is employed to construct a Bent sequence generator, and the results prove that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Portable Human Information Integration System for Evaluation Plantar Force
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, to develop human movement information collecting system with SD card as storage medium. To establishes the human body and computer's relation. The hardware design of the system with PIC32MX microcontroller and the advantages of data recording using SD card are presented. To acquire 6-channel transducer signal to record SD card through serial peripheral interface were reviewed and analyzed on computer. Using this system union related transducer that may prompt and accurate gathers the human body movement information. Then, carry on the experiment with piezoelectric polymer film transducer in soles, the results show that the development system can be used for evaluation plantar force. Secondary development on the basis of the data acquisition platform can be applied to the training of recuperating one's health, physical training, sport training, surface EMG and so on.

articleTitle: Research of the Measure System in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The measure system in power plant based on Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing technology was put forward after the signal sources are described firstly, connected with communication and monitoring networks existed already. In this system, wireless sensor networks or carrier transmission on power line or fiber-optic is used in fully mechanized working face and electric power line systems is used as broadband networks in order to make complete signal transmission system. This system has the advantages of economy,cheapness, good protective measure and “No New Wire”, and exploit the advantage of OFDM, such as strong anti-interference. We compared the typical wavelet basses in practical application, analyzed the effects of the orthogonal bases and its character of orthogonality, compactly supported and vanishing moments in system. System structure of the powered support' communication system and hardware design, main motion flow of the monitoring equipment were pointed out in this paper.

articleTitle: The Research on Model Integration and Optimization of the Design of Virtual Campus
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The paper discusses the overall design scheme of the system of virtual campus of the Suzhou University of Technology and Science in detail, and proposes specific methods of systemic model integration and optimization aiming at the problems in the demo of systemic model, for example, low efficiency on downloading files and browsing over websites, etc, and guarantee against the congestion of network.

articleTitle: Almost Compactness Degree on L-topology
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The notion of almost compactness degrees is introduced in L-topological spaces by means of the implication operator "→" of L. An L-set G is almost compact if and only if its almost compactness degree ACD(G) = T. Some properties of almost compactness degrees are investigated.

articleTitle: Harmonic-Suppression System Based on Fuzzy Neural Control in Power Line
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Sources of interference in power line are summarized. An adaptive approach to suppression of the harmonic currents based on the classical way of harmonic injection and artificial neural network is presented in this paper. The ANN keep in contact with inputs and its weights are adjusted through BP algorithms,its output can vary adaptively with the input. Membership functions of fuzzy neural variables and control rules are shown. The computing load is not very large compared with the traditional methods. It is a new use of the control system based on fuzzy neural control. This method builds a harmonic-suppression system and uses active power filter and power filter to realize power line communication based on ElectroMagnetic Compatibility.

articleTitle: Spray Characteristics of New Generation Multi-hole Injector for Spark-ignition Gasoline Engines with Direct Fuel Injection
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the spray characteristics of a new generation multi-hole injector for spark-ignition gasoline engines with direct fuel injection (DISI) and homogeneous combustion system. In order to satisfy the design request of combustion system, numerical simulates the liquid spray progress using currency commences star-cd code. In the work, the injection pulse rule is kept almost constant. But the investigation parameters are varied categorical in different steps for each parameter (fuel pressures, fuel temperature, air pressure, air temperature and swirl). Deeply research the spray parameters (spray penetration, sauter mean diameter (SMD) and evaporated rate) in every work condition.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization on Automotive Steering Mechanism with Clearances
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Automotive steering mechanism is designed applying a theoretical method of robust optimization. A math modal on steering mechanism with clearances based on robust optimization is established. The movement precision in fourteen positions of steering mechanism during steering course is chosen as objective function. Distance between kingpins, axle-base, the bottom angle of trapezoid mechanism and the length of steering arm are chosen as design variable. And clearances in motion joints of steering mechanism are chosen as noise factor. Design variable and noise factor are both considered as random variable with normal distribution. Constraints are included in the minimum transmission angle and the maximum turning angle error, etc. Optimum results are shown that the movement precision of steering mechanism is assured even if clearances are existed in motion joints or clearance size is varied.

articleTitle: The Development of SCADA System for Subsea Blowout Preventer
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the design and implementation of an extremely reliable system to remotely monitor and control the subsea blowout preventer (BOP) stack by using triple modular redundancy technique. The system hardware architecture including surface component and subsea component are proposed. The control logics, human machine interface (HMI) graphical design and redundant databases are development by using off-the-shelf software. An experiment of subsea BOP control is performed in the laboratory. The results show that the system can give correct alarms when mistakes occur, and all subsea BOP functions can be performed correctly.

articleTitle: Underwater Nonlinear Information Fusion Algorithm Based on Hydrodynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the underwater vehicle positioning precision, a new underwater nonlinear information fusion algorithm based on hydrodynamic model and unscented Kalman filter was proposed. Hydrodynamic dead reckoning model represented sailing nonlinearity preferably, and the algorithm using unscented Kalman filter avoided linearization error. To confirm the position estimate capability of the nonlinear fusion algorithm, a sea trial was made. The results of sea trial demonstrate that the filtering accuracy and stability of the new nonlinear information fusion algorithm are better than Kalman filtering algorithm based on linear model. This nonlinear fusion algorithm can estimate position effectively even when underwater vehicle is maneuvering, and improve the estimated position precision of whole underwater sailing.

articleTitle: Structure Reliability Analysis of Disaster Protection of Catenary for Railway Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, simulations of railway catenary supporting system have been performed with finite element method (FEM) in different wind and ice-coating disasters with or without a locomotive passing by. The results of stress and displacement indicate that existing catenary supporting structure is capable of meeting the requirement on strength and stiffness in most cases, though, the contact wire will have an excessive deflection if the wind velocity is at 37m/s and higher or the thickness of ice-coating exceeds 20mm. Measures shall be taken in such cases and the junction between inclined cantilever tube on supporting brace and strut shall also be reinforced. Achievements of this paper will be theoretical reference for disaster prevention design and operation of traction power supply system in relative engineering area.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management Model of Logistics Based on Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Grid technology can achieve full connectivity of network resources, eliminate information silos, and thus realize resource sharing. Through standardized management of knowledge, the knowledge excavation, access and reuse can be facilitated. Because of the limitation of information management object, it is difficult to achieve the goal of intelligent logistics system, making logistics information inevitably develop towards the knowledge management phrase. Network technology integrates the relevant organizational and individual knowledge scattering in different regions of the world into logistics management process thus make the knowledge integration get rid of the time and space constraints. The paper constructs the model of logistic knowledge management frame, explores the grid-based knowledge acquisition and processing methods, and establishes the acquisition and classification model of logistic information knowledge as well as the logistic knowledge mining model of customer-oriented needs, which is conductive to a high degree of resource sharing and efficiency.

articleTitle: Heuristic Algorithm Based On Flooding Structure In Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to avoid routing overhead and reduce management fee for transmisson of routing information, we purposed two heuristic algorithms which are self-pruning algorithm and dominant pruning algorithm. This algorithm is more efficient than the aimless flooding in wireless networks, and redused unnecessary transmission of information and nodes switching by the movement between neighbourhoods. Result shows that the two kinds of flooding algorithms are obviously superior to the aimless flooding algorithm, particularly the performance of the dominant pruning could almost reach the limit.

articleTitle: The Calculation and Analysis of SINOPEC Tianjin Company's OPF
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Structural features has been analysed after the third part of SINOPEC Tianjin company's power system been put into operation. Node voltage been treated as the constraint, minimum power loss been treated as the objective function, used PSASP to calculated the different way of generator's combination, the voltage , power flow, power loss has been compared before and after the OPF calculation. The conclusion indicated that, by changing the active power and reactive power of generators, OLTC and reactive-load compensation equipments, the system's power flow operated more reasonable and economical. The enterprise revenue has been maximized. This is instructive and meaningful to the operation of SINOPEC Tianjin company's power system.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of Energy-saving Control System for Wastewater Treatment
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: For the large energy consumption of the blast aeration system in the sewage treatment, we took intelligent control technology for dissolved oxygen control, emission index meeting the Class A and achieving comprehensive energy-saving. The simulation shows a good effect, and finally be realized under the Siemens PLC.

articleTitle: A Discuss and Study on the Structural and Seriation Design of the New Composite Hub Connection
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Through the traditional hub couplings typical shortcomings of the structure, and calculation and verification on the involute spline expansion and sleeve's bending load capacity, has established the new structure type of composite hub connection. To further reduce its production costs, increase their interchange ability, so that the structure of the field in more widespread application. On the structure serialization of this type corresponding is discussed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Natural Gas as Locomotive Engines' Fuel
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To resolve the problems of oil resource deficiency and locomotive engines' pollution, we try to seek substitutes. Analyzing several possible alternative fuels, the article find the most suitable alternative fuel is natural gas. Calculate the performance and emissions of the locomotive engines burning natural gas by using numerical simulation method. Results demonstrate that burn natural gas almost meet the requirements of power and torque, and NOx emissions could be effectively improved. With the ignition time delay, the peak combustion pressure drops, the time to peak also delays; the maximum rate of pressure rise with the ignition delay time decreases; torque output dropped obviously with the ignite time advance; CO emissions get to a minimum value at a certain ignition time. All the simulation results are from the rate speed and full load, the results have certain limitation.

articleTitle: Illumination Component Separation Method Based on Independent Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In the field of computer vision, since the image of an object is negatively influenced by illumination, material, texture, shadows, and so on, it is often necessary to separate the illumination components (diffuse and specular reflections) from the intrinsic information of an image. In this paper, the diffuse and specular reflections are regarded as mutually independent components. By analyzing the coefficient matrix of the illumination components and incorporating it into independent component analysis, the diffuse and specular reflections are separated. The experiment results reveal that the proposed method is feasible and has a better separation precision.

articleTitle: Miniature Field Bus Data Recorder
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The common bus on bus control is RS232. With the development of field bus technology, field bus technology is widely used in data recorder. How to real time record the data of field bus in the experiment and provide the test data for process reconstruction is a very important problem. This paper introduces a kind of data acquisition and storage based on field bus. Its core design is C8051F040 microprocessor and SJA1000, a widely used field bus controller. This paper presents the basic constitution of this field bus data recorder and set forth its hardware and software. This field bus data recorder field bus real-time gathers the information and storage data on the CF card. The result of the experiment shows the system is highly reliable for data acquisition and storage, which should have abroad application prospect for data record experiment.

articleTitle: WMOS: A Wireless Message-Oriented System for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The information dissemination in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) is an important but complex and challenging problem. Designing suitable communication primitives for these systems is critical. One of these primitives is the publish/subscribe paradigm. The data-management task in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) should be performed such than limited resources like memory, processing and power are utilized very efficiently. A message-oriented middleware system based on pub/sub paradigm has been proposed in order to both facilitating the development of these applications and providing common application services. This paper explores a middleware for WSN named WMOS (Wireless Message-Oriented System) which is developed based on TinyOS. WMOS proposed in this paper for managing the request for data and events from sensor nodes and responses that are provided to the users who set the request in P2P-WSN is Publisher/Subscribe based. The three main features of our middleware are the following: First, WMOS is well-adapted to scalable systems without compromising any subscription criteria or network reorganization,our solution is fully distributed and modular, thus making it appropriate for practical implementations. Second, we supply self-adapt multilevel QoS service in order to save limited resources efficiently. Third, By WSN application, we propose topic/content double mode based on XML matched, query information very efficiently than other middleware systems.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis for Planetary Gear Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A math model on planetary gear is built based on deterministic optimization method. The minimum volume of planetary gear is chosen as optimization objective. Teeth number of sun gear, face width, module and gear number are chosen as design variable. Applying Monte Carlo method robustness on the planetary gear is analyzed. Robustness analysis is included in probability distribution of objective and constraints, while design variables are considered as independently random variables of normal distribution. It is shown that planetary gear based on the deterministic optimization method is not robust when design variables show a slight variation. Precise of design variables is set up again based on the robustness analysis conclusion, and robustness on planetary gear is improved to meet design requirements.

articleTitle: The Study of Permeability Change of Fractal Under Fracturing Basing on Damage Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to research the evolution of permeability and damage of fractal rock under hydraulic fracturing, a new damage variable that describing relative reduction of pore amounts as radius is bigger than r any fracturing stage is defined. Assuming the process of evolution of micro-fracturing is in accord with standard model of Logistic bifurcation theory, according to energy conservation principle, the models of rock damage and infiltration of evolution under hydraulic fracturing were established based on damage theory. then the evolution model of rock is also done. One well of Ji Lin oil field is chosen, the changes of porosity and permeability were calculated, the results coincided with engineering practice.

articleTitle: An Outlying Reduction Algorithm Based on Power Graph
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper puts forward an outlying reduction method based on the power graph. The outlying reduction problem is due to the search of power graph. This paper utilizes the pruning strategy on the basis of the power graph expansion, which greatly reduces the storage and computation and improves the algorithm performance. This method can explain and analyze outliers in a smallest outlying subspace which contains the most outliers. The algorithm is illustrated by an example and the experimental results show the feasibility and efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on CNC Machining Technology for Conformal Sapphire Dome
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: CNC machining is an important process to solve problem of difficultly machining for single-crystal sapphire. In order to receive single-crystal conformal sapphire dome, this paper reviews a series of processing experiments, analysis and optimization of process parameters. It receives a set of complete conformal sapphire dome CNC machining technology and the optimal process parameters.

articleTitle: Security Risk Evaluation Model on Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of computer, insecurity factors(such as computer virus, hacker) influences the development of MIS, safety risk evaluation has been an important task. This paper describes a risk evaluation method for MIS based on fuzzy set theory which uses linguistic variables and respective fuzzy numbers to evaluate the factors. The primary weights of factors and evaluation of alternatives are determined by applying linguistic variables and fuzzy numbers. The notion of Shapely value is used to determine the global value of each factor in accomplishing the overall objective of the risk evaluation process, so the primary weights are revised, thus the importance of factors can be reflected more precisely. A major advantage of the method is that it allows experts and engineers to express their opinions on safety risk evaluation in linguistic variables rather than crisp values. An illustration is presented to demonstrate the application of the method in risk evaluation. The results are consistent with the results calculated by conventional risk evaluation method. The research demonstrates that the method is objective and accurate, and is an application value in the risk evaluation for MIS.

articleTitle: A Research on the Fractal Properties of Aluminum Future Market
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The fractal properties and scaling behaviors of aluminum future price is numerically investigated by Detrended fluctuation Analysis (DFA) of a scaling analysis method which is used to estimate long-range power-law correlation exponents in noisy signals. Through DFA method, the scaling exponents α of DFA1, DFA2, DFA3, DFA4 and DFA5 are inspected. Moreover, the relationship of time cales and the scaling exponents α is studied carefully. The results show that the phenomena of fractal can be detected and the long-range memory is found at the time series of the aluminum future price. It means that the aluminum future market is not weak-formed efficiency and the price of aluminum future follows a bias random walk.

articleTitle: Research of Hydraulic Pressure Suspension Technology of Half-axle Structure and Multi-axle Special Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To resolve the problem of the Hydraulic pressure suspension system pipe explosion-proof, this paper used the method of theoretical analysis and simulation experiment, compared the advantages and disadvantages of the suspension system to several explosion-proof programs and concluded: Two-pipe and single-spool explosion relief valve attached poppet valve explosion relief valve can reasonably resolve the explosion-proof problems of hydraulic suspension system.

articleTitle: An Efficient Blind Ring Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Anonymous technology is an important identity protection technology, it can realize the privacy-preserving of the user. As two important cryptographic technologies, blind signature and ring signature can realize anonymity, thus, they play very important roles in realizing the anonymity of user's information. To fit with the requirement in real life, we propose a blind ring signature scheme by combining ID-based cryptology and anonymous signature. And we give formal security proof of anonymity, blindness and unforgeability of our scheme in the random oracle model. In terms of computational cost and the signature size, we show that our scheme is more efficient, two pairing operators are involved in the signing and verifying phase, respectively.

articleTitle: Texture Image Recognition Using Bispectrum Slice
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a novel texture recognition method using bispectrum slice. The first step, Radon transform, was to reduce the dimension of the image data. The second step was to calculate bispectrum and extract bispectrum diagonal slices as texture features. The third step was to apply principal component analysis(PCA) for reducing the dimension of feature vectors. Finally, BP(Back Propagation) neural network based on resilient BP algorithm was used as training and classification. The results show the bispectrum slice is more successful than gray level co-occurrence matrix(GLCM), and has a recognition ratio of 87.33%. The bispectrum-based approach can effectively recognize different texture images and sufficient texture information can be obtained.

articleTitle: Aspect-Oriented Modeling Based on Behavior Context: A Bridge from Asymmetric to Symmetric
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Traditional Aspect-Oriented Model approaches are need to distinguish core components and aspect components at early stage. Aspect-Oriented Modeling based on Behavior Context (AOMBC) is a new approach for Aspect-Oriented Software Development (AOSD). With AOMBC, the developer could model the system actions symmetrically. To collaborate with other behavior nodes, behavior context is been using to describe their relationships. With the behavior context, the equitable behavior nodes are asymmetric warped to core-behavior or crosscutting-behavior and weaved together. As a result, AOMBC can obtain both benefits of symmetric and asymmetric, help the developers to build more effective and reusable models.

articleTitle: Research on Methodologies of Draining and Decompressing for Pipe Network in Lining Channels
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: It's required to decompress with the draining pipe network when there is a relatively high groundwater level outside of the lining channels. The self-draining pipe network is composed of longitudinal collecting underground pipes, transverse communicating pipes and non retern drain valves. The pipe flow might be laminar flow or turbulent flow determined by the discharge. The turbulent flow might be in the hydraulically smooth region, hydraulically transition region or hydraulically rough region. When the pipe flow is laminar flow, the equation set for solutions is linear which can be calculated in finite element method with no iterative computations; When the pipe flow is turbulent flow, the equation set for solutions is non-linear which can be calculated in finite element method with iterative computations.

articleTitle: A New Method of Generating Excited Signal and its Application in the Piezomagnetic Type Shape Meter
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The function of excited signal, in the generation, transmission and extraction process of measuring signal in the piezomagnetic type shape meter, was particularly analyzed, and its importance of signal quality to measuring accuracy of stripe shape was showed clearly. Aimming to the various disadvantages of traditional methodes on generating excited signal, a new method based on microcontroller was proposed. Following the method given, a exciting power system for the shape meter appling to the 1250 HC cold rolling mill of ANSHAN IRON AND STEEL GROUP CORPORATION was developmented. Industrial operation shows this exciting power system can provide the current-collecting device of shape meter and signal processing system with high-quality excited signals. The distortion degree of measuring signal is greatly reduced in the process of transmission and extraction, sequentially, the measuring accuracy of stripe shape is significantly improved. This method offers a new way for exciting circuit design, and has much reference to produt design relating to excited signal.

articleTitle: Design of Test System on Nighttime Driving Behavior and ECG Characteristics of Long-distance Bus Drivers (I) - Test Design
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: For the safety issues of night long-distance bus drivers, a test system that real-time continuously acquires vehicles driving parameter, traffic environmental images as well as ECG physiological state of drivers under night-time driving conditions is designed. The impact of continuous driving time, night-time conditions and others on the driver's heart electrical parameters and driving behaviors is studied. The experiments were carried out on 11 drivers and the total journeys were over 11,800 km. The experiments' results indicate that: The long-distance bus drivers. The driver's average heart rate shows a downward trend as the driving time extends. And the average heart rate while driving is 13~18 times higher than the average heart rate while resting. Under night highway free-flow conditions and the highest safety speed 100 km/h of the passenger transport company regulations, the driver's 50%, 75% and 95% percentile speed are 93.6 km/h, 99.3 km/h, 103.2km/h respectively, and 50%, 75% and 95% of the throttle pedal position are 75%, 85%, 90% of the largest pedal trip respectively.

articleTitle: Planning Model of Expressway Emergency Rescue Station Based on Respond Time
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Expressway emergency rescue system is important for the expressway safety management.Through analyzing the traffic incident on expressway; this paper proposed a model based on respond time for the planning of expressway emergency rescue station. We analyze the characteristic of each expressway section by the historical statistics of traffic incidents, such as the number of incidents, casualties, property damage and other indices. The dangerous degree of each section has been calculated, and the section's requirements of rescue resource have been computed. On this basis, we study the relationship between the system response time and the distribution of the rescue station, we build an optimal location model for the rescue station distribution, by the lowest total cost as the goal, and the system response time as constraints. Finally, in the paper we proposed the method and steps to find the model's satisfying solution by using of genetic algorithm, and give examples of the application of the distribution model.

articleTitle: VME Bus Interface Circuit Design and Its ASIC Implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: VME bus system has high performance of stability and throughput, which is widely used in avionics systems. In order to replace the VME bus interface chip on many daughter boards in system, VME bus interface is implemented via FPGA, and layout design through ASIC development tools is also provided. The VME bus module is integrated into a single chip on board with other IP cores to simplify hardware design complexity and improve the robustness and the stability of systems.

articleTitle: A New Approach of Generating Atmospheric Path Radiation Images Based on MODIS Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The remote sensing technology is of importance to monitor air quality due to its real-time and convenience in rural or montane areas. Based on regression analysis method and histogram analysis method, a new approach of generating inhomogenous atmospheric path radiation images based on MODIS remote sensing images is put forward by water, cloud and land surface computed alone mainly. The experimental result shows that this method is able to compute atmospheric path radiation values under inhomogenous atmosphere effectively. Meantime, Comparing with 6S proves its worth and validity strongly. Finally, it provides another new way to study on atmosphere environment research in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Selection Method of Urban Road Network Structure Form
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This article analyzes and summarizes adaptability of different road networks, combining with road network characteristics and road network layout feature. The factors that influence the selection of road network structural form are proposed and their limitations to the selection of road network structure form are also given. Considering these factors, this article provides reasonable and practical method to select road network structural form. Specific cases of urban road network structural form are finally illustrated to explain the proposed selection method of urban road network structural form.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Image Segmentation Method Based on Gray Vision Parameter
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to make the fingerprint image pre-processing algorithm be more consistent with human visual cognitive processes, we accorded to visual perception model to calculate visual experience gray value, and calculate the parameters of the fingerprint image segmentation, achieved a new method. First, the fingerprint image is segmented using the method called OSTU with the physical gray value; Second, using Gray Vision Limens Function (GVLF), the Gray Vision Parameter(GVP) is figured out based on the physical gray value; Third, the converted fingerprint image is segmented also using the OSTU with the GVP; Last, the binary fingerprint image is done also using the OSTU method. The experimental result shows that this four-step segmentation method improves the effective of the poor quality fingerprint image, such as “Peeling”, “Black back ground”, “Tint”, and “Break”. Compared with the classical segmentation method, OSTU, our method could take more accurate segmentation and information from corrupted part of the poor fingerprint images and gets the more complete fingerprint images.

articleTitle: The Process Reconstruction on Energy Saving of Convective Drying System
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The rational energy saving reconstruction had been carried out for the process of convective drying system. Through analyzing the economic benefit of the system before and after the process reconstruction, the conclusion can be obtained that the reconstruction project can produce considerable economic benefit for the enterprise. The second phase process reconstruction application has proved the feasibility of the process reconstruction and has certain social significance and value of application.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Tire Lateral Self-excited Vibration Based on MSC.Marc User Subroutine
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Simplifying the tread-road model, a finite element model of the tire tread lateral self-excited vibration using LuGre friction model is established in MSC.Marc. With the finite element model, the lateral self-excited vibration of tread is simulated and analysed. Spectral analysis of the vibration signal is carrid out as well. At last, the influence of vehicle speed on lateral self-excited vibration of tire tread is presented. The results prove that high frequency vibration exists in tire tread under certain conditions and the value of the vehicle speed has essential influence on the existence and the amplitude of the vibration.

articleTitle: Research on the Profile Matching of New or Worn Wheel/Rail
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: General profiles chosen from worn wheel profiles and railheads (briefly, worn wheel and rail profile) measured by wheel-rail profile admeasuring apparatus were used to build the finite element models, and the new/worn wheel-rail contact problems were analyzed respectively on the tangent and curved track. Variable regulations of contact area's size, shape and position were generalized. The results show that, on the tangent and curved track, contact area's acreage is small and the peak point of equivalent stress is large occur in the model of new wheel-old rail, which indicates that turning worn wheel profile into original profile is unreasonable. Compared with other models, the contact model of old wheel-old rail shows the largest contact area's size, and such wheel-rail matching is the best one, which provides references for designing the turned wheel profile to adapt to worn railhead profile and reducing the wear of wheel and railhead profile.

articleTitle: On Singular Configuration of a Four-Degree-of-Freedom Parallel Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Singular configuration of a four-degree-of freedom three-leg parallel manipulator is researched in this paper. The discriminant expression and geometrical conditions leading to singular configuration of the manipulator are obtained. Especially, three kinds of singular configuration are given. The mechanism with simple symmetric structure and large stiffness can be applied to build industrial robots and parallel machine tools. This research will play an important role in promoting the application of such manipulators.

articleTitle: First Coming Clustering Algorithm Based on Reputation in Peer-to-Peer Network
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the security problem and broadcast storm problem of cluster in P2P, a first coming clustering algorithm based on reputation is presented. This algorithm, taking reputation as one of the criteria for the evaluation of a node, is to improve the secure of the interactions between nodes. And it also effectively resolve the broadcast storm risks by optimizing the structure of cluster, such as adding weights to the nodes, applying criteria on a new initialization, reputation threshold, division, virtual backup and the cluster's disbandment. Simulation results showed that the proposed algorithm improves the security of the system and significantly reduce the broadcast storm.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Flexible Manipulator Finger Based on OHM
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Applied the artificial muscle based on oil hydraulic to design flexible manipulator finger joint. Builded mathematical model to express the relation among the structure parameters, workplace and dynamical features of the driving joints. According to the characteristic of flexible hydraulic components and the arrangement of the flexible components in driven band, proposed the driven principle to control the movement of flexible finger in different ways. Laid a theoretical foundation for practical application.

articleTitle: Fast and Low-Complexity Frame-Level Synchronization for Differential Transmitted Reference Receivers
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A frame-level synchronization (FLS) algorithm for the UWB differential transmitted-reference (DTR) receiver is designed and analyzed in this paper. In DTR systems, the detector computes the decision statistic by correlating pulses from adjacent frames and summing the contributions from the entire frame of a symbol. Symbol-level synchronization is not enough for data modulation single the position of low duty cycle signal in each frame is still unknown. The algorithm which we proposed has a moderate accuracy but a very low complexity and fast synchronization speed compared with conventional approaches requiring subnanosecond-level accuracy. Detailed analysis of the algorithm is carried out based on our in-depth analysishis.

articleTitle: A People-centric Sensing Approach to Transforming Cross-Cultural Practices in a Global Virtual Team Setting
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Cultures are nowadays perceived as critical and value resources for organizations. To be competitive in the globalized economy, business operations must leverage cultural differences and avoid conflicts and fragmentation through understanding, cultural melding, appreciation, and adaptation. This paper presents our preliminary study focusing on transforming cross-cultural practices in a virtual team setting, aimed at improving the team's project development performance. In order to explore this innovative approach, we look into the following tasks in a stepwise manner: 1) defining a generic computational model of a virtual team; 2) identifying corresponding measures for the people-centric interactions during the operations of a virtual team; and 3) exploring methods to create transformative actions (e.g. strong virtual group components, better communication protocols and information sharing, cultural melding, leadership, etc.) to ensure operational practices in conformance with the best practices for continuous improvement on collaboration, people-centric sensing, and viability.

articleTitle: A Web-based Computer-Aided Material-Selection System for Aircraft Design
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: A web-based computer-aided material-selection system for aircraft design, together with its architecture and implementation details, is put forward. Furthermore, a prototype of this system is developed and the prototype's effectiveness is demonstrated by an aircraft-design material-selection case in actual applications. This system can help designer select suitable materials for airframe, provide knowledge for inexperienced engineer and accumulate enterprise-level material-selection expertise.

articleTitle: An Optical Distance Measuring Method Using Non-Contact Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper describes a new framework of laser triangulation method for measuring the distance according to the basic principles of traditional laser triangulation method, which spread the range of the traditional measuring method. This method measure the distance for particle subsection by using three independent CCD that distribute uniformly along the optical axis and detect by using the plain reflected mirror as virtual detector which is equivalent to another CCD in the system when the beam image on the CCD. Collimator filter is composed of collimation system, polarizer and diaphragm, which reduce the impact of accurate measurement that measured surface is not ideal optical spot by reducing diameter of the imaging point on photosensitive surface of virtual detector, at the same time add light intensity control system to ensure stability of beam that control light intensity only fluctuating in a small range. The results of the system are effective agreement with the experimental observation.

articleTitle: A Basic Study on E-interview
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper defines the concept of E-interview, analyze the advantage of E-interview and elaborate the reason of the application scope of the E-interview in the current personnel selection. This paper not only points out the important position and the applicable scope of the E-interview in the current personnel select, but also does the basic estimate to the application foreground of the E-interview. For making good use of E-interview in the business and government, it also gives some suggestions about the preparation of the hardware and applicants.

articleTitle: Tourists' Cognitions to Home Stay Service Management in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In the past, setting up home stays in Taiwan was simple to meet the tourists' demand of lodging. Now, in answering the soaring demanding about traveling quality, some home stays begin to provide better and comprehensive services. By applying Factor Analysis, we examine tourists' demands and cognition of satisfaction to home stay service management in various parts of Taiwan. The purpose is to provide knowledge for all, not only in Taiwan, home stay owners a better understanding about the needs of tourists in order to increase their willingness to pay visits again.

articleTitle: The Scene Improvement of Jiefang Truck's Engine Packing Line
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The scene improvement of productive process is an indispensable aspect for an enterprise. It is the foundation and guarantee of the enterprise's operation and management's success. In this paper, based on the analysis of Jiefang Truck engine production packaging lines, the logistics of the production line, flat layout, handling, balance and work place have been improved. So wastes can be eliminated and production efficiency can be increased.

articleTitle: Combinatorial Evaluation for Forewarning Grade of Emergency in Urban Mass Transit
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To evaluate the forewarning grade of emergency in urban mass transit comprehensively, a new combinatorial method combined with color warning was proposed. The evaluation factors which could influence the emergency were divided into external factors and internal factors. External factors were mainly decided by the evacuation wave in stations. Internal factors mainly included Interrupt Time, Casualties, Happen Position, Property Loss and Sphere of Influence. These internal factors constituted an evaluating indicators system. The results demonstrate that the combinatorial evaluation not only fulfills the comprehensive safety assessment for emergency in urban mass transit, but also catches the emphases in different situations.

articleTitle: True AC Root-mean-square Measurement Based on the Calculation of Cycle Double-end Sampling Values
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: When non-synchronous sampling measurement method was applied to the measurement of AC RMS, the increase in the measurement error was resulted from the existence of the RMS calculation error. A new non-synchronous sampling true RMS measurement method and implementation of the program was presented in this paper, and RMS calculation error greatly reduced through distributing the sampling values of cycle double-end. Analysis and calculation showed that: for an AC signal with the fundamental frequency of 50 Hz, the RMS calculation error was less than 0.00012% when the frequency of period sampling was more than 128 times, and with the increase in the frequency of sampling, the error decreased faster. This error was much smaller than the quantization error of an A / D converter in measuring. The first advantage of the measurement meter designed based on this method is fast response speed, which can be seen in the result that the true RMS of the former cycle can be obtained at first time sample of the next cycle. Additionally, the second advantage is high measurement accuracy, and the third advantage is that it suits for the situation of AC frequency fluctuation and so on.

articleTitle: Toll Calculation Method of Regional Freeway Network Based on Traffic Flow Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In order to analyze the effect of toll standard of regional freeway network on traffic flow assignment, this paper presents a network tolling model based on the optimization of traffic flow. In this model, system optimization and user optimization are considered together, cost of road users is minimized as the objective function, and the benefit of road builders and external benefit are treated as the constraint requirements. Confronting such a complex problem, genetic algorithm is induced to solve the constructed model and a case example validates its effectiveness and feasibility of real use. The result shows that the model can make the traffic flow assignment of freeway network more reasonable.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study on Wind Farm Renewable Energy Development in the Eastern Coast of China
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Eastern China has a vast land area with a long coastline, presenting a possible wind resource. But the use of the wind renewable energy to generate electric power is still on a small scale, because of the large upfront investment and lower internal rate of return. In this paper, the project of wind farm is used as a Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) case to reveal the mitigation cost per unit CO2. This investigation is based on baseline and incremental cost analysis. The case study has been made with capacity of 30MW wind power project. It is shown that development of wind farm is feasible in the eastern coast of China. The establishment and operation of the proposed project activity will promote the wind farm technology and utilization. It can also achieve the greenhouse gas emission reductions and promote the sustainable development at the local areas.

articleTitle: Theory of Service Economy: A Review of the Literature
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The paper provided an overview of the recent theoretical and empirical research on service economy. We structured our review around questions likely to be of interest to scholars and policymakers. The paper started with a review of the literature on Baumol's model that was one of the principle theories on service economy. It proceeded with a presentation of the determinants of the rising employment share in services relative to manufacturing industries. The paper then reviewed the theoretical literature on the agglomeration of service sectors. In this paper we focused on the link between deregulation of services and the performance of the manufacturing sector and economic growth. Our review identifies a number of important opportunities for future research on service economy.

articleTitle: Construct Boolean Functions with Optimum Algebraic Immunity
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: By using the relationship between some flats and support of a n variables Boolean function f, we introduce a general method to determine the algebraic immunity of a Boolean function and finally construct some balanced functions with optimum algebraic immunity.

articleTitle: Some Considerations on the Parameters Selection of DEM Simulation for Tumbling Ball Mills
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Linear-spring dashpot model is one of the major contact models applied to the DEM (discrete element method) simulation of the tumbling ball mills. The model parameters such as stiffness, damping coefficient, coefficient of restitution and coefficient of friction, significantly influence the calculation of contact forces and the selection of the critical time step. However, there is no standard as a reference to evaluate values of these parameters. This paper focuses on the selection of parameters for the linear-spring dashpot model. The movement of a single ball in a tumbling mill is performed in a simulation in which the elevated heights of the ball are compared with the theoretically analyzed heights under different coefficient of friction conditions. The results show that this kind of comparison is feasible and meaningful for the selection of model parameters.

articleTitle: Optimum Piping Design on Offshore Platform Based on Improved Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: For solving the problems of low efficiency and high cost in piping design process on offshore drilling platform, the design of manifold optimum piping was taken as research objective, a mathematical model was established with the controlled objects of construction and operation costs. The general adaptive algorithm was improved by projecting the encouraging function to deal with constraints, design of variable probability parameters and the establishment of evaluation mechanism. Simulation experiments show that, the task of optimum piping design on offshore platform could be accomplished by the optimization method based on improved adaptive genetic algorithm and costs were reduced and piping design efficiency was enhanced effectively. Comparing with the algorithm performance not optimized, evolution efficiency, convergence rate and stability of improved algorithm were obviously superior.

articleTitle: Study on Service Response Logistics in Retail Banking Based on E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: With competition between commercial banks getting fiercer, exploring and expanding retail banking business has inevitably become one important choice for banks to increase competency. But traditional way of providing retail services greatly constraints the expansion of business and is not conducive to the increase of customer satisfaction. Therefore, trying to seek a new way to serve retail customers is of great importance. Service response logistics as a concept points out the direction of service management and e-commerce provides specific means to implement service response logistics. This paper introduces some relative terms, discusses application status of service response logistics in China, points out the significance of the concept to retail banks and the main activities involved. Finally, this paper analyzes in what way e-commerce can better implement service response logistics.

articleTitle: The Signal Acquisition System of the Grating Displacement Sensor Based on CPLD and USB Interface
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: According to the rectangular pulse signal of the grating displacement sensor, the system realized the displacement signal acquisition, through the grating signal processing and the computer interface. Signal acquisition system of the grating displacement sensor was composed of the grating signal processing circuit based on CPLD and USB interface communication controlled by MCU. Subdivision and direction-judgment module, counter module, interface module, all of which were included in the grating signal processing circuit and the design methods were introduced in detail. Using CPLD chip EPM7128 realized grating signal processing. Adopting USB interface chip CY7C68013, data transmission between CPLD and host computer was carried out. The signal acquisition system of the grating displacement sensor shows the displacement of the grating displacement sensor through the computer application program interface, it has small volume and it works stably and reliably. The range of this system is 0-200mm and the resolution is 5μm.

articleTitle: A Computational Model for the Normal Pressure between the Tube and the Hydroforming Die
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The normal pressure between the tube and the die in the guiding zone has a great effect on the friction force. Therefore, it is an important consideration in the design of tube hydroforming process. In the present study, a mathematical model for calculating the normal pressure between the tube and the die in the guiding zone is proposed. It is shown that the normal pressure is determined by the Poisson's ratio of the material, the ratio of the outer diameter to the inner diameter and the internal pressure. Simulations and experiments of free forming are performed. The simulation and experimental results show that the mathematical model proposed is very reliable.

articleTitle: A Sequential Frame Method for Traffic Sign Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the sequential video frame, a method to detect the traffic sign was proposed. The color image was mapped from RGB to improved HSI color space first, and then converted it to binary image according the color of signs. The shape features were used to remove some noise, and the improved Hough transform was used to locate the areas of traffic signs. Compared to the existed detection algorithm, a previous frame was used as a priori information to reduce the treatment region, then to decrease the computation. In order to prevent the undetected region, a full inspection was processed when the number of consecutive frames which detected the traffic signs was more than the threshold. The results show that the method in this paper performs better than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Curve Reconstruction of Turbulence Motion Locus Based on Image Projection Transformation and Light Stream Vector
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Curve reconstruction method of turbulence motion locus is investigated. Through tracing particles be equally-distributed scattered into flow field and each particle’s movement has been shot from different orientations in continuous time-points, thus sequential conjugate images have been obtained. On the basis of positioning these particles in each relative coordinate system, relationship of image projecting transformation is established to calculate their absolute three-dimensional coordinates in each time-point. Combining with light stream vector, tracing particles’ motion vectors in each instantaneous moment can be deducted. Finally B-spline spatial curve of turbulence motion locus is fitted. Programming experiments and error analysis indicate that the accurate locus curve can be obtained, turbulence’s mathematical feature and motion discipline are clearly displayed, and this method provides theoretical foundation and technical preparation for following turbulence research.

articleTitle: NOx Storage Performance at Low Temperature over Pt/BaO/Al_2O_3 by Plasma Treatment
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The study on NOx Storage Performance at low temperature over Pt/BaO/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> by plasma treatment in this paper, the structure and activity of catalysts are characterized and tested respectively by using BET, TPR, SEM, TPD,XRD and FTIR. The results of FTIR spectra are shown that catalyst by non-plasma treatment has weak oxidbillity for NO, on the surface of catalyst, there are major adsorption species of bridge nitrite, and a small quantity of monodentate nitrate, bidentate nitrate and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> adsorbing species. There are major monodentate nitrate on the surface of catalysts by plasma treatment, the catalysts by plasma treatment have highly metal dispersibility and biggish specific surface area, which should improve NOx storage capacity at low temperature.

articleTitle: Exploring the Shipping Logistics Operations Mechanism Based on the Theory of Ecological Population
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper summarizes the meaning and characteristics of shipping logistics. Based on the similarity between shipping logistics and ecological species, the paper analyzes the population characteristics of shipping logistics. Referring to the logistic growth model of ecology, this paper builds a one-single-agent logistic growth model for shipping enterprises. For multi-agents shipping enterprises, this paper examines the competitive and cooperative relations between the different agents.

articleTitle: The research and analysis about extrusion production of the de-airing pug mill variable temperature field based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, has analyzed the pug’s temperature field in the extrusion process of de-airing pug mill with ANSYS, based on the thermal parameters of different friction coefficients, different outside temperatures, the mud’s different heated temperatures to carry out numerical simulation of the movement soil material, reveals how the ceramic soil material impact on the flow characteristics in the extrusion process under different temperature, provide theoretical basis for the extrusion production of the ceramic pug.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis about Transmission Components in C Parts of Direct-drive Bi-Rotary Milling Head
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: In a direct-drive high-power A / C-axis bi-rotary milling head,torque is transferred by two parallel connected rotary direct drive motors in C-axis, therefore, the length of C axis is inevitable large, moreover, the transmission components of it are bearing high torque. Through analyzing the twist stiffness of the transmission components in C-axis by the finite element method, the result that the torsion deformation of the sleeve accounts for a large scale in transmission components of C parts is found. In the permitted extent structural design of C-axis, the stiffness of transmission components in C parts is increased effectively through shortening the sleeve and lengthening its external diameter.

articleTitle: The Application of Discrete Particle Swarm Optimization In Attitude Determination
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Attitude determination with navigation satellites is a key technology in aviation, marine and land navigation. In the method based on carrier phase difference, the double difference integer ambiguity solving is important and difficult. This paper adopts Discrete Particle Swarm Optimization to search for the optimal integer ambiguity directly without the decorrelation of ambiguity, and calculates the baseline vector consequently. This method can improve the efficiency of integer ambiguity solving, so as to be applied in dynamic attitude determination. The experimental results show the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Time Budget and Its Application on Destination Choice
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Research on the relationship between individual trip decision behavior and activity space choice helps to understand whether the existing transportation systems meet the travelers' demand. Based on the survey data of the Jilin city which made the time budget the research object, we analyze its distribution along with activity space and estimate the influence factors. These works lay the foundation for the analysis combining decision behavior from micro view of personal perspective and macro view of space. Also, they help us understand the decision theory of behavior more accurately and apply a new way to analyze the interaction between space and city life

articleTitle: Application Study about Hierarchical Network Planning Based on Lingo in Manufacturing Corporation
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: To solve the gigantic and complicated project management problems of Manufacturing Corporation, authors combine theory with the practical situation of project management, apply arithmetic of Hierarchical Network Planning method. This method based on Lingo can optimize the time limit and time limit-cost. Through applying the shortest path theory and random theory, corporation can confirm the best project management plan synthetically and improve time limit and time limit-cost deeply.

articleTitle: Optimization of Structure Parameters for the Head of the Anti-flood Spiral Pile
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: During the driving process, to reduce Power Input and improve Portable Performance of the anti-flood spiral pile equipment, it needs to deduce the Resistance Torque of computational formula for the head of the anti-flood spiral pile between soil, which bases on establishing the Pile-soil Interaction Mechanical model for the head of the anti-flood spiral pile and combining with soil spherical cavity expansion theory. Then, take the resistance torque as the objective function, and the spiral diameter, blade width, thread pitch as optimization variables. In MATLAB write programs, call Fmincon optimization function, and it can obtain a reasonable optimization results.

articleTitle: Study on Service Management Innovation Based on Relationship Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: The appearance of relationship marketing theory brings a great difficulty and many challenges to service management. To manage the service better, this paper compare the two management modes of service quality and relationship quality. Differing from the static, macro-layer management mode of service quality management, the management of relationship quality emphasizes on the dynamic, micro-layer, long term relationship quality between customer and service firm, which greatly improves the effectiveness and efficiency of service management. Therefore, traditional service management should be changed into the innovation mode focusing on relationship quality. Eventually, this paper puts forward some strategies from angles of relationship investment, relationship technology and relationship culture.

articleTitle: Study on Management Factor of Construction Machinery Host Machinery Corporation Supplier
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: Factor analysis and structural equation model are used to construct the model of factors analysis of supply chain management of enterprises on the engineering machinery. It shows that the order of main factors of supply chain management based on enterprises of engineering flexibly and agilely is descending as brand operation, credit service, agile response and flexible cooperation and these main factors are relevant directly, the relation among the factors, the supply chain management of enterprises and the supply chain of engineering machinery efficiently are also relevant directly.

articleTitle: A Research about Traffic Safety Character of two-lane highway in Plain Area Basing on Random-effect negative binomial model
publicationTitle: 2010 WASE International Conference on Information Engineering
abstract: This paper reviews the studies which have been performed in two-lane highway traffic safety research, and select random-effect negative binomial model to illustrate the traffic safety character of two-lane highway in plain area. More than 1380 kilometers(about 56 highways) two-lane highways in Beijing and Shandong province are investigated and the traffic safety data are collected, such as accident data, geometric data and roadside data. The highways are divided into 1772 segments. The result shows that the random-effect negative binomial model provides a better result than basic model.
